9000164.en: Coordinated by you and Xi Zhao, your Sect members effectively finished the construction of a Flying Canoe. Now, they are getting on board.
9000164.ch: 在你与奚照的统筹下，宗门之人迅速建好飞舟，准备启程。

9000165.en: There is a loud rumble, and the Flying Canoe rises slowly into the sky. It travels among the clouds as if it has been inspired by the Heavenly Path.
9000165.ch: 只听一声巨响，飞舟缓缓升空，穿行于云层间，仿佛受到了天道的感召。

9000166.en: After a while, the Flying Canoe arrives at your destination. You see a magnificent Sect building here, completed by the Cultivator Alliance.
9000166.ch: 片刻后，飞舟抵达了赤幽州特定位置，仙盟已然在此建立起一座气势恢宏的宗门。

9000167.en: Congrats on migrating to Chi You, my friend! I believe you will make great contributions to the Cultivator Alliance!
9000167.ch: 恭喜小友宗门迁来赤幽州，以后必能为我仙盟做出巨大贡献。

9000168.en: Gu Yuan'er moves to specified locations while casting specific spells. Thus a portal appears in front of you.
9000168.ch: 只见顾鸢儿在此地按照特定方位移动着，同时伴随着特定的法术动作，一道传送阵就出现在你们眼前。

9000169.en: The portal is activated. Let's go!
9000169.ch: 传送阵已开，我们出发吧！

9000172.en: There is no trace of monsters around the Heaven Sacrifice Altar. It looks like Taowu is not here.
9000172.ch: 祈天台周围并未发现妖兽气息，看来那梼杌此刻并不在这里。

9000174.en: Well, the barrier is amazing indeed. Fortunately, my father left a record when participating in its construction; otherwise, I am afraid I won't be able to crack it.
9000174.ch: 嗯，这祈天台的结界果然不凡，幸好我爹当年也参与了搭建，留下了一份记录，不然只怕一时半会我也无法破解。

9000175.en: Yuan'er uses her energy to break the barrier around the Heaven Sacrifice Altar. After a while, a strange lock engraved with sixty-four trigrams appears at the entrance to the Altar. Once touched, several positions on the lock are lit up.
9000175.ch: 只见顾鸢儿运转灵力在祈天台开始破除结界，一番行动之后，祈天台入口便显示出一个篆刻天干地支六十四卦的奇特锁环，稍一碰触之后，数个方位顿时点亮。

9000176.en: The entrance is open. Let's get in. The Altar is divided into four areas, one of which has a switch to the self-destruction array. Let's split up to search for it.
9000176.ch: 入口打开了，我们快进去，祈天台分为四个区域，其中一个区域有自毁的阵法开关，我们分开寻找。

9000177.en: You see several rooms after entering the Altar.
9000177.ch: 进入祈天台后，里面竟然有数个房间

9000178.en: In the Recluse's Room are futons and beds. It must be a cultivation room for the cultivators stationed in the Altar before. There are no switches here.
9000178.ch: 云房之中陈列蒲团坐床，想是昔日入驻祈天台修仙者专心修炼的地方，你未在此地发现任何阵法开关。

9000179.en: There are tons of unknown elixirs in the storeroom, but no switches are found here.
9000179.ch: 饵阁之中仍有大量不知名丹药，你未在此地发现任何阵法开关。

9000180.en: In the Library stand many bookshelves, on which many books are rotten. Some books have fallen onto the floor, leaving the whole room in a mess. There are no arrays or switches here.
9000180.ch: 编纬阁中陈列大量书柜，上面许多书籍都已朽坏，部分散落地上，让阁中显得十分凌乱，你未在此地发现任何阵法开关。

9000181.en: Entering the Multipurpose Room, you see Gu Yuan'er sitting on the ground, fiddling with something.
9000181.ch: 进入器用无穷室中，你看见顾鸢儿盘坐在地上摆弄着什么。

9000183.en: Yes, this is a switch to the self-destruction array. But it's not easy to activate. I need more time.
9000183.ch: 没错，这便是祈天台自毁的阵法开关，不过开启颇有难度，我需要花一点时间。

9000184.en: Wait a minute. There are some things in the Heaven Sacrifice Altar that I must take away. I will activate the self-destruction array after I find them.
9000184.ch: 等一等，祁天台里有些东西我必须带走，找到后我再启动自毁阵法。

9000185.en: You may leave first. I will leave when I find what I want.
9000185.ch: 没事，你先走，我找到东西后自会离开。

9000186.en: After that, Gu Yuan'er starts to search.
9000186.ch: 顾鸢儿说完，便自顾自地找了起来。

9000187.en: (Forget it. I'd better wait for her right here. Taowu may not show up...)
9000187.ch: （罢了，就在此地等她吧，也许梼杌不一定会出现……）

9000188.en: Fifteen minutes later, Gu Yuan'er seems to have found what she wants.
9000188.ch: 一刻钟之后，顾鸢儿似乎找到了自己想要的东西。

9000189.en: Found them. I will activate the array right away.
9000189.ch: 东西找到了，我这便启动自毁阵法。

9000190.en: In an instant, there is a loud noise from the roof of the Altar—a monster has broken in after the barrier is dissolved.
9000190.ch: 顾鸢儿话音刚落，祈天台顶立即发出一阵巨响，竟是一只妖兽在结界破解后飞了上来。

9000191.en: How... did Taowu... come up here?
9000191.ch: 这……梼，梼杌凶兽……怎么会突然出现？

9000192.en: Yuan'er, would you continue activating the array? I will deal with this monster.
9000192.ch: 鸢儿，你继续开启这个自毁阵法，我来解决此兽。

9000193.en: {name|A}, I-I'm sorry. If it weren't for me, Taowu wouldn't find...
9000193.ch: {name|A}，对，对不起，若不是我，本可以不被梼杌发现的……

9000194.en: I'm halfway there. The self-destruction array will be activated soon.
9000194.ch: 我已经破解到一半，很快便能启动自毁阵法。

9000195.en: At that moment, the Taowu you defeated appears again. Its mouth spurts out a lot of Nether Air at this time, shrouding the Altar in darkness. The monsters nearby seem to be invigorated by the Nether Air and start charging at the Altar.
9000195.ch: 就在这时，那已经被你击杀的梼杌竟再度出现，喷出大量冥气，祈天台上顿时黑雾笼罩，附近妖兽仿佛受到冥气召唤驱使，纷纷猛冲祈天台。

9000196.en: According to my father's book, a monster with Nether Air Condensation can't be defeated with ordinary means... Even if we send me a telepathic voice to Aunt Luo now, there may be no time left...
9000196.ch: 糟糕，传闻妖兽若将冥气凝结成晶体之状，则非寻常手段可以击杀……眼前梼杌已养成冥气结晶，现在哪怕传音姑姑，可能都来不及救我们了……

9000197.en: {name|A}, I'm sorry. It is my fault that you...

9000198.en: Before Gu Yuan'er transmits her voice, she sees in the distant sky hundreds of flying swords appear, which disrupt the formation of monsters. A middle-aged cultivator leads Luo Ying and other members of the Cultivator Alliance to jump into the monsters and fight them.
9000198.ch: 顾鸢儿还没来得及传音，便看到远方天空出现数百道飞剑，劲射而来，将台下妖兽阵势打乱，一中年修士率领骆英等仙盟成员，瞬间杀入兽群，与之恶战。

9000199.en: But thanks to the nourishment of Nether Air, the monsters seem to be inexhaustible. Many disciples of the Cultivator Alliance are seriously injured. At that moment, a golden crow descends from the sky and spews out pyro to disperse all the Nether Air around the Altar.
9000199.ch: 但在冥气的滋养下，妖兽仿佛杀之不尽，不少仙盟弟子受了重伤。就在此时，一道金乌从天而降，喷出赤炎，将祈天台周围数百里的冥气尽数驱散。

9000200.en: After the dissipation of Nether Air, the monsters lose their source of power and are soon wiped out by the Cultivator Alliance. The golden crow transforms into a human and hovers in the sky.
9000200.ch: 冥气消散后，妖兽没有力量来源，很快便被仙盟消灭一空，金乌化成人形，悬于高空。

9000201.en: My name is Luo Ying. Are you Lady Sunny?
9000201.ch: 老身骆英，敢问可是……圣阳娘娘！

9000202.en: Yes. I feel the call of the Altar.
9000202.ch: 不错，本座感受到了这祁天台的召唤之意，便降临到此地。

9000204.en: Sunny turns her head to you.
9000204.ch: 圣阳目光一转，便看向了你。

9000205.en: Ah, it's you, {name|A}. Long time no see. You've reached {grade|A}!
9000205.ch: 竟然是{name|A}，你这小家伙，多年不见，你都已到{grade|A}了。

9000206.en: Nice to meet you, Lady Sunny. I'm Xiang Lingjun, Master of the Cultivator Alliance. You seem to know {name|A} before, don't you?
9000206.ch: 在下仙盟盟主向令钧，见过圣阳娘娘，感谢娘娘出手相助，看样子，娘娘和这{name|A}小友是旧识。

9000207.en: It was years ago. {name|A} did me a big favor.
9000207.ch: 那是很多年前的事了，{name|A}当初也算帮了我大忙。

9000208.en: Congrats, {name|A}! As an old friend of Lady Sunny, you've made a great contribution even though you've just joined the Cultivator Alliance!
9000208.ch: {name|A}小友不愧是和圣阳娘娘相识之人，初来我仙盟不久，便立下如此大功，真是英雄出少年。

9000209.en: I cannot stay here very long. For the sake of the favor {name|A} did for me, I will disperse the Nether Air on you.
9000209.ch: 我在此界无法久留，观你们冥气颇为严重，看在{name|A}的份上，本座再为你们出手一次。

9000210.en: Sunny takes to the sky and waves her sleeves, summoning the sunlight to pierce the Nether Air toward Chi You. The Nether Air surging around Alliance dissipates. Sunny turns into a golden crow and disappears into the sky.
9000210.ch: 圣阳说完，脚下一点，轻飘飘飞上半空，她袖子招了两招，天上阳光穿破冥气，照向赤幽州，将仙盟周遭冥气尽数散去，随后圣阳化作金乌，消失在天际。

9000211.en: {name|A}, I saw you on the wall that you entered the Alter from early on. Why did you stay there for such a long time?
9000211.ch: {name|A}小友，我在城墙遥望，看你们很早就进入了祁天台，为何在里面如此之久？

9000213.en: By then, Gu Yuan'er has walked to Luo Ying's side after activating the array.
9000213.ch: 此时，在祁天台内的顾鸢儿，也完成了阵法的启动，走到骆瑛身边。

9000214.en: Master, Aunt, the self-destruction array has been activated. The Altar will be destroyed in 15 minutes. Let's leave now!
9000214.ch: 盟主，姑姑，祁天台自毁法阵已经开启，一刻钟之后便要自毁，我们速速离去吧！

9000215.en: Before Gu Yuan'er finishes talking, Luo Ying slaps her, leaving a red handprint on her fair face.
9000215.ch: 哪知顾鸢儿话音刚落，骆瑛便一巴掌打向了她，只见她白皙的脸上留下了一道红色的手印。

9000216.en: Aunt... why do you hit me?

9000217.en: Who allows you to take the liberty to find other things in the Altar? If you activated the array a little bit earlier, we wouldn't have had so many disciples injured.
9000217.ch: 你还好意思说，若你不擅作主张去寻找其他东西，而是早早启动自毁阵法离去，何至于让诸多仙盟弟子为了你身负重伤。

9000218.en: If I don't teach you a lesson today, who knows what kind of trouble you will get into?
9000218.ch: 今日不让你长个教训，以后不知道还要闹出多大事。

9000219.en: I told {name|A} to leave first. I don't care to die alone in the Altar and you don't have to save me.
9000219.ch: 我早就让{name|A}先走了啊！若只有我一个人，你们没必要来救我，死了就死了，这样便能去找我爹了！

9000220.en: Gu Yuan'er covers her face with her hand and leaves with an agitated look.
9000220.ch: 顾鸢儿捂着被打的那侧脸，神情激动地离开了。

9000222.en: No worries. She will be fine in a while. Sorry to keep you waiting.
9000222.ch: 没事，她自己呆一会反思反思就好，倒是让盟主和小友见笑了。

9000223.en: Elder Luo, Yuan'er is still young. There is no need to be so harsh on her. Although many disciples of the Cultivator Alliance were injured, the Altar didn't fall into Jiuying's hands after all. Besides, Yuan'er has helped the Cultivator Alliance retrieve the items left in the Altar.
9000223.ch: 骆长老，鸢儿还小，不必如此苛责。虽说仙盟弟子不少负伤，但此番祁天台不仅没落入九婴之手，仙盟更是拿回遗落在祁天台的物品，鸢儿倒也算功过相抵。

9000224.en: Thank you, Master, for showing leniency to her.

9000225.en: At that moment, Gu Yuan'er, who has been immersed in the study of the array, gets the array activated.
9000225.ch: 此时，在一旁专心研究祈天台自毁法阵的顾鸢儿，也完成了阵法的启动。

9000227.en: Pass my word: take all the items in the Altar back to the Cultivator Alliance.
9000227.ch: 所有人听令，将祈天台内的东西在一刻钟内尽数带回仙盟。

9000229.en: Fifteen minutes later, just as you leave the Altar, you see the Altar crushed to pieced by the energy within.
9000229.ch: 一刻钟后，你们刚离开祈天台，便看到高台被法阵内的能量毁成了尘碎。

9000230.en: A strange howl is heard from the distance. Master points his finger toward it, and you see the silhouette of a nine-headed monster in the dense Nether Air.
9000230.ch: 此时远方一声奇特叫声发出遍传大地，盟主向令钧抬手一指，那冥气浓重之处，竟隐约有一九头妖物向天啸叫。

9000231.en: When you find Gu Yuan'er, she is sitting on top of a lush hill holding her knees. Next to her stands a tombstone with a few words engraved on it: In Memory of Gu Nangang.
9000231.ch: 你找到了顾鸢儿，发现她正抱着双膝坐在一座青葱翠绿的山头之上，旁边立着一块墓碑，上面刻着几个字：顾南罡之墓。

9000232.en: As if having not noticed your arrival, she quietly stares at the tombstone in front of her. After a long time, she slowly speaks up.
9000232.ch: 顾鸢儿仿佛没有察觉到你的到来，依旧安静地望着眼前的墓碑。许久之后，她才缓缓开口。

9000233.en: My mother died when I was born. It was my father who raised me. Perhaps because of guilt for my mother and me, he gave me the best that he could ever give.
9000233.ch: 娘在我出生的时候便死了，是爹爹一直抚养我长大，也许是因为对娘和我的愧疚，他把世上最好的一切都给了我。

9000234.en: When I needed some kind of rare spiritual fruit for cultivation, he went into the depths of Chi You to find it. Three days later, he brought the fruit back, with injuries all over.
9000234.ch: 我修炼需要某种珍稀灵果，他便深入赤幽州深处去寻找，三日之后他浑身是伤地把灵果带了回来。

9000235.en: When I was surrounded by monsters on a trip, he did not hesitate to burn his blood to come over and kill all the monsters. For that matter, he even irritated Jiuying.
9000235.ch: 我外出历练身陷妖兽重围，他不惜燃烧精血快速赶来，把那群妖兽全部屠光，甚至惹来了九婴一击。

9000236.en: Although my mom died early on, I was lucky to have the best father in the world.
9000236.ch: 虽然我很早就没了娘，但庆幸我还有世界上最好的爹。

9000237.en: But, why did heaven take my father away from me...
9000237.ch: 可是，为什么上天连我爹都要夺去……

9000238.en: Back then, the Cultivator Alliance organized a large number of cultivators to siege the last generation of Jiuying. Jiuying was killed eventually, but the Cultivator Alliance also paid a huge price.
9000238.ch: 当年仙盟组织大批修士，围攻上一代九婴，虽然最后九婴被击杀，但仙盟也付出了巨大的代价。

9000239.en: My dad died in that battle. It was the Master who took his body back.
9000239.ch: 我爹便在那一战中牺牲了，还是盟主亲自把他的尸体带了回来。

9000240.en: What he left behind were only those books he wrote on arrays. A large part of them was kept in the Altar.
9000240.ch: 自从爹走了后，他留在世上的东西，便只有那些他亲手写下的阵法书籍，但其中一大半都存在了祁天台中。

9000241.en: Therefore, when I have the opportunity to enter the Altar, I can't help but want to find and take away all those books.
9000241.ch: 因此当我有机会进入祁天台时，便忍不住想把那些书籍都找到带走。

9000242.en: In fact, I also think I was too impulsive at the time. In that place surrounded by monsters, I shouldn't have put you in such danger. I'm sorry...
9000242.ch: 其实事后我也觉得自己太冲动了，在那群兽环伺的地方，竟然还拉着你一起同我冒险，对不起……

9000245.en: I heard what you just said. Your father's death is a pain for me as well.
9000245.ch: 你刚说的，我都听到了。你爹的死，对我来说又何尝不是一种痛苦。

9000246.en: But you can't ignore the big picture because of your own pain. If everyone in the Cultivator Alliance acts like this, how are we supposed to counter Jiuying?
9000246.ch: 但不能因为自己的痛苦便忽略大局，若仙盟之中人人如此，还如何做事，如何对抗九婴？

9000247.en: I slapped you in the face, but it hurt in my heart. Many disciples of the Cultivator Alliance have been injured for your sake. I slapped you so that they won't hold a grudge against you. Do you understand?
9000247.ch: 姑姑那一掌，打在你脸上，又何尝不是疼在我心里。此番仙盟为了你，确实有不少弟子受伤，这一掌，也是为了给他们一个交代，你明白吗？

9000249.en: Luo Ying walks up to Gu Yuan'er, holds Yuan'er in her arms, and gently strokes her back.
9000249.ch: 骆瑛走到顾鸢儿面前，慢慢地把她抱进怀里，轻抚她的后背。

9000251.en: Gu Yuan'er can no longer hold back and cries silently in Luo Ying's arms.
9000251.ch: 顾鸢儿此刻再也忍不住内心的难过，在骆瑛怀里默默地哭泣着。

9000252.en: Rest assured, my friend. I'll take care of Yuan'er. The Master has something to say to you. Just go ahead.
9000252.ch: 小友，你放心吧，鸢儿有我照看，盟主有事招你前去，你快去吧。

9000253.en: There you are. The destruction of the Altar has been a wish of mine all these years. Thank you for making it happen.
9000253.ch: 你来了，祈天台被毁，也算了我一番心事，这中间，你功不可没。

9000254.en: Please take this {0} as your reward. It is one of the Martial Arts taken back from the Altar.
9000254.ch: 有功就得赏，这{0}是祈天台带回的功法之一，便算作你此番的奖励，莫要推辞。

9000255.en: Elder Luo told me that you are here because you are on your way to Tian Yuan Mountain, right?
9000255.ch: 骆长老和我说过，你到此地是为前往天元山？

9000256.en: I admire your courage, my friend. Unlike us, you have the guts to head to Tian Yuan Mountain at such a young age.
9000256.ch: 小友年纪轻轻，便敢于前往天元山，这份锐气可佳，不似我等，修行多年，都已有了一丝暮气。

9000257.en: Haha, forgive me for being so sentimental.
9000257.ch: 哈哈，一时有些感慨，倒让小友见笑了。

9000258.en: If you are going to Tian Yuan Mountain, you've got to go deep into Chi You. But the monster wave has blocked the way. So why don't you help us resist the monster wave first?
9000258.ch: 小友想进入天元山，势必要前往赤幽州深处，如今兽潮来袭，前往赤幽州深处的路被妖兽堵住，不若先随我等一同抵御兽潮，如何？

9000259.en: A Wave of Monsters like this was never seen before. The charging monsters seem to be maneuvered in coordination with each other. Suddenly, a roar is heard in the distance. Several elders are fighting a monster capable of spitting out fire and water, and they are barely holding out.
9000259.ch: 眼前兽潮异于寻常，冲突而来的妖兽分进合击之际暗含法度，仿佛有人调度，此时远方突然响起轰鸣，几名长老围攻一只能吐水火的凶兽，却被打得节节败退。

9000260.en: We are all wounded, and it's not wise to continue the battle. We should retreat today and come back to kill the monster after we recover... Luo Ying, would you please gather the disciples of the Cultivator Alliance and retreat inside the walls?
9000260.ch: 大家都已负伤，再作纠缠恐怕也讨不了好去，今日先避过九婴锋芒，来日我们养精蓄锐再击杀此兽，骆瑛，你组织仙盟弟子退到城墙之内。

9000262.en: Under the command of Luo Ying, the disciples of the Cultivator Alliance fighting the monsters beyond the wall begin to retreat, and the monsters have no choice but to assault the wall. Their attack lasts for half a day before they leave.
9000262.ch: 在骆瑛主持之下，出城抵挡兽潮的仙盟弟子陆续撤退，妖兽无奈只能猛冲城墙，半日后才渐渐散去。

9000263.en: Many disciples of the Cultivator Alliance have been injured in this monster wave. How about you, {name|A}?
9000263.ch: 此次兽潮，仙盟诸多弟子都受了伤，{name|A}小友伤势如何？

9000264.en: Amazingly, you are unharmed despite the fierce fight with the monsters. No wonder you are heaven-chosen.
9000264.ch: 小友不愧是天骄，在兽潮中出如此大力，还能保全自身，比其他仙盟弟子强太多了。

9000265.en: In the monster wave, the fire- and water-spewing fierce monster besieged by the Master and several elders was Jiuying. Although they failed to defeat Jiuying, the monster is said to be seriously injured.
9000265.ch: 此番兽潮，盟主率领几大长老围攻那能吐水火的凶兽，便是九婴，虽说未能取胜，但听闻九婴也受了重伤。

9000266.en: If we can take advantage of this opportunity to strike, we may be able to kill Jiuying in one go. It's just no one knows where Jiuying is located.
9000266.ch: 此番九婴重伤，修为短时间内会猛跌，若能趁此机会出手，可一战定乾坤，可惜，无法知道这九婴所在之地。

9000267.en: At that moment, you and Luo Ying hear a refreshing voice of a woman.
9000267.ch: 就在此时，一道清冷的女声响彻在你和骆英的脑海中。

9000268.en: I feel a faint hibiscus fragrance on Jiuying. If I guess it right, it must be recuperating somewhere outside the city walls.
9000268.ch: 本座感受到那九婴身上有很淡的扶桑枝气息，不出意外，眼下它便在城墙外某处的一个巢穴之中疗伤。

9000269.en: Was that voice from Lady Sunny?
9000269.ch: 刚才，刚才那道声音，可是圣阳娘娘？

9000270.en: If what she said is true, it is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. Since our disciples are all injured, I'm afraid we have to count on you to kill the monster. Would you...
9000270.ch: 若真的如此，实在是千载难逢的机会，眼下仙盟弟子各有伤势，恐怕唯有小友可前往诛杀此妖兽，不知……

9000271.en: It's such an honor to have {name|A} on our side. But you may not be familiar with Chi You. I will ask Yuan'er to lead the way for you.
9000271.ch: 人族有{name|A}，实是大幸。不过小友对赤幽州并不熟悉，我让鸢儿带着前去。

9000272.en: No worries, Aunt. I will go with {name|A}. We will try to kill Jiuying to avenge my father's death.
9000272.ch: 不必担心，姑姑，我愿意陪{name|A}前去，若真能杀了九婴，便能为爹爹报仇了！

9000273.en: My friend, you know Yuan'er's father died in the hands of Jiuying. She doesn't talk about it much, but she has long had the idea to avenge his death. So would you allow her to go with you?
9000273.ch: 小友也知，鸢儿她爹早年死于九婴之手，虽然明面不说，但其实心里一直想着为她爹报仇，小友就让她跟去吧。

9000274.en: My friend, you know Yuan'er's father died in the hands of Jiuying. She has long had the idea to avenge his death. So would you allow her to go with you?
9000274.ch: 小友也知，鸢儿她爹早年死于九婴之手，她心里一直想着为她爹报仇，小友就让她跟去吧。

9000275.en: Don't worry. I won't hold you back. If there is any danger, you don't have to worry about me. Just keep yourself safe.
9000275.ch: 你放心，我不会拖你后腿的，若真有变，你不必在意我的安危，优先保全自己。

9000276.en: More people, more power. This is her choice. Even if she died in the hands of Jiuying, I would not blame you, my friend.
9000276.ch: 多一个人多一份力量，这是鸢儿自己的选择，真死在九婴之下，老身也不会责怪小友。

9000277.en: Following Lady Sunny's instructions, you come to a deep cave, which Yuan'er finds very weird upon your arrival. She ponders for a long time until she casts a spell to open a crevice on the wall.
9000277.ch: 你们根据圣阳的指点，来到了一处幽深的洞穴，鸢儿一经踏入随即察觉古怪，她苦思良久，竟使用某个禁咒在山壁上打开了一个缝隙

9000278.en: Look. You should be grateful for bringing me here. I can be a good helping hand.
9000278.ch: 看，让我跟着来没有错吧，可不准嫌弃我了！

9000279.en: Pfft, it's just a joke. I know you worried about me and I'm thankful for that.
9000279.ch: 噗嗤，逗你玩的，我知道你是担心我，这份心意我记在心里呢……

9000280.en: I'm not stupid, but I've got to avenge my father's death. Thank you for letting me come with you. All right, let's go in.
9000280.ch: 我又不傻，但爹爹之仇不能不报，谢谢你愿意让我一起来。好啦，我们进去吧。

9000281.en: After you enter the crevice, you find that it is not a mountain cave at all, but an exquisite and clean hut with furniture and even books of human beings on the table as if someone used to live here.
9000281.ch: 你们进入缝隙之后，发现里面根本不是山洞，而是一间精致干净的小屋，有着各种家具，桌子上甚至还有数本人类的书籍，仿佛有人在此生活过。

9000282.en: Isn't this Jiuying's lair? Why does it feel like a human's?
9000282.ch: 这不是九婴的巢穴吗，怎么感觉像是人住过的地方。

9000283.en: You search around but fail to find any trace of Jiuying. In a drawer, however, you find a bronze mirror.
9000283.ch: 你在周围查看了一番，并未发现九婴踪迹，却在一张案几的抽屉之中取出了一面铜镜。

9000284.en: Seeing the bronze mirror, Gu Yuan'er is somehow lost in thought.
9000284.ch: 顾鸢儿看着你手中的铜镜，渐渐陷入了沉思。

9000285.ch: 你手里这面铜境，怎么有点熟悉……

9000286.en: Just as you touch the mirror, you feel an inner upheaval, and countless scenes appear in your Mind Sea.
9000286.ch: 你碰触那面铜镜，突然间内心产生剧震，同时识海幻出无数画面。

9000287.en: A middle-aged cultivator is handing over a bronze mirror.
9000287.ch: 画面中一名中年修士递来一面铜镜。

9000288.en: I made this artifact to locate Jiuying. However... it's imbued with Nether Condensation. The Nether Air can corrupt one's mind and expose one's soul, and it will only do harm to whoever uses it often in the long run. But Jiuying is a much more urgent threat. We must use it to get it over with quickly despite its side effect.
9000288.ch: 我专门制作此法宝，可以用来识别九婴位置，不过……镜中灌注冥晶，冥气侵蚀神识，照妖之余亦照内心，长久使用可对你我没什么好处，只是眼前一切以对付九婴为重，只好使用此物，速战速决。

9000289.en: A middle-aged cultivator looks solemn as he holds a monster in his hands.
9000289.ch: 画面中一名中年修士手捧怪兽，脸上尽是凝重。

9000290.en: Jiuying is dead... But it has given birth to a cub. We must kill it too...
9000290.ch: 九婴虽死……不想竟诞下一子，我们必须将之杀死……

9000291.en: You see a man in his twenties sitting with crossed legs behind the bars. He keeps smiling and talking.
9000291.ch: 你看见一个二十岁左右的男子正盘坐栅栏之中，他满脸都是笑意，一直在说话。

9000292.en: Our forefathers knew a long time ago. Monsters? They don't want to fight us cultivators either. Our narrative is actually the opposite of what has happened in Chi You. It's not monsters invading cultivators' territory, but cultivators occupying monsters' habitats.
9000292.ch: 我们家的先辈早就知道了，妖怪么？也不想对付我们修仙者，其实赤幽州的事情，要反过来看，不是妖兽要冒犯修仙者的地盘，反而是修仙者在一步一步压逼妖兽，让其失去生活的地方。

9000293.en: Are you okay, {name|A}? You look pale.
9000293.ch: {name|A}，你还好吗？怎么脸色都变青了。

9000294.en: Thank God. I was so worried about you. Since Jiuying is nowhere to be found, let's go back first.
9000294.ch: 那就好，刚才你那模样，担心死我了，既然九婴没找到，我们先回去吧。

9000296.en: I'm glad you are back. What about Jiuying? Have you found it?
9000296.ch: 你们安全回来就好，那九婴呢，你们可曾找到？

9000297.en: It might have sensed something and run away in advance. And the weird part is that the place doesn't look like a monster's lair.
9000297.ch: 估计是它感知到了什么，提前跑了吧，而且那里不似一个妖兽居住之地，好奇怪。

9000298.en: I should have known that it would not be easy to kill Jiuying.
9000298.ch: 果然，九婴岂是那么好杀的，我是想得太简单了。

9000299.en: Aunt, I've got to find something to eat. You two take your time.
9000299.ch: 姑姑，我好饿，先去找点东西吃啦，你们慢慢聊！

9000300.en: After Yuan'er leaves, you take out the bronze mirror and hand it over to Luo Ying.
9000300.ch: 待顾鸢儿走后，你拿出了那面铜镜，递给骆瑛。

9000301.en: Isn't this the Artifact made by Nangnag, Heavenly Insight?
9000301.ch: 这，这不是南罡当年制作的法宝“天目”吗……

9000302.en: According to Nangang, it is used to track Jiuying. But abusive use may affect the user's mind. It's an Artifact with both benefits and harms.
9000302.ch: 依南罡所言，此物可用来追踪九婴位置，但用多了亦会反噬使用者神识，是件利害并生的法宝。

9000303.en: I think the Nether Air in the mirror may have affected your mind. That's why you can see some of the records kept in the mirror.
9000303.ch: 老身以为当是镜中冥气侵蚀小友神识，导致你看见镜中之前记录下来的一些片段。

9000304.en: The Artifact must have run out of energy. I remember Nangang once said, the Heavenly Insight is powered by Nether Condensation. If you can find Nether Condensation, there may be a chance to reactivate it.
9000304.ch: 应该是此法宝没能量了，我记得南罡曾说过，这“天目”是以冥晶为源，若你能寻到冥晶，或许可以再度启用它。

9000305.en: The Heavenly Insight can indicate the whereabouts of Nether Condensation. Now that the monster wave has receded, you can go outside the city walls and inject energy into it. Then it will tell you where Nether Condensation is located.
9000305.ch: “天目”自身便有感应冥晶之能，此刻兽潮刚退，城墙之外相对安全，你可到城墙之外，对其注入灵力，它会显示冥晶所在之地。

9000306.en: As you arrive at this place and inject energy into the Heavenly Insight, the bronze mirror starts to tremble. It displays your current location and a purple-black dot not far away from you. After a while, it is back to normal.
9000306.ch: 你刚走到此地，对天目注入灵力，它突然间发出震动，上面竟显现出你目前地图方位并在不远处标出一个紫黑色的圆点，但是不过片刻，镜子重新没了动静。

9000307.en: Does it mean there is Nether Condensation?
9000307.ch: 难道那处地方有冥晶，过去看看。

9000308.en: You arrive at the location marked by the Heavenly Insight, but fail to find any Nether Condensation. Instead, you meet a female cultivator.
9000308.ch: 你来到天目标记的地点，但并没有发现任何冥晶，反倒是遇到了一名修仙女子。

9000309.en: My friend, although the monster wave has receded, it is still very dangerous outside the city walls. Please return to the city as soon as possible.
9000309.ch: 这位道友，如今兽潮虽退，但城墙之外依旧十分危险，还请速速返回城内。

9000311.en: The woman turns around and leaves after saying that emotionlessly.
9000311.ch: 女子面无表情地说完，便转身离开。

9000313.en: Again you inject energy into the Heavenly Insight, which marks another location. But unlike last time, the mark doesn't disappear.
9000313.ch: 你再次对天目注入灵力，这次天目又标记出了一处地点，不过倒不会像上一次那般，顷刻间没了动静。

9000314.en: Hope I can get something this time.

9000315.en: This time, you do find a cave. Purple crystals are attached to the wall of the cave. Those must be Nether Condensation. It's just there is a monster sleeping in the cave.
9000315.ch: 这次你果然发现了一处洞窟，洞中石壁之上一片片的紫色晶体，看来那便是冥晶，但洞中正有妖兽在沉睡。

9000316.en: To avoid an unnecessary fight, you conceal your breath and slowly fly to the stone wall and quickly remove the Nether Condensation.
9000316.ch: 为了避免不必要的战斗，你隐去气息，缓缓地飞到石壁之上，快速将冥晶取下。

9000317.en: Just as you are about to leave after taking the Nether Condensation, the monster wakes up from its slumber and rushes toward you abruptly.
9000317.ch: 就在你取完冥晶将走之际，妖兽从沉睡中醒了过来，猛然向你冲了过来。

9000318.en: The monster is defeated by you. Just as you are about to kill it, the woman shows up again.
9000318.ch: 妖兽被你击败后，你正要将其毙命之际，先前那女子再度出现。

9000319.en: Hey, my friend, the monster just wanted to drive you away. It was not intended to kill you. So would you just let it go?
9000319.ch: 道友，这妖兽起初也只是想将你赶跑，并无杀你之意，就此罢手吧。

9000320.en: The woman then looks indifferently at the monster, which becomes well-behaved and backs out all of a sudden.
9000320.ch: 随后该女子冷漠地望向妖兽，只见该妖兽顿时变得变得乖巧，飞快地退了出去。

9000321.en: See? The monster is not hostile for no reason. If you were willing to communicate with it, this fight might have been avoided.
9000321.ch: 你看，这妖兽也并非不通人意，一昧屠杀。你若一开始愿和它沟通，也许这场战斗本可避免。

9000322.en: All right. Forget it. You may not understand...
9000322.ch: 罢了，现在跟你说这个，你也不明白……

9000323.en: This woman does not answer your question at once. It's not until she goes afar that you hear her voice from the distance.
9000323.ch: 此女子并没有马上回答你的问题，再度转身离开，待其走远后，你放听到她遥远的声音。

9000324.en: By the way, I'm Duanmu Yinglan.

9000325.en: What a mystical woman! Forget it. Since we've got the Nether Condensation, let's go back and ask Elder Luo how to activate the Heavenly Insight.
9000325.ch: 此人颇为神秘……罢了，既然冥晶已拿手，先回去找骆长老询问这天目启动之法。

9000326.en: {name|A}, you brought the Nether Crystal back?

9000327.en: My Aunt is busy with something. She told me to wait for you here and help you activate the Heavenly Insight.
9000327.ch: 姑姑刚有事离开了，她让我留在这里等回来，帮你激活天目镜。

9000328.en: Gu Yuan'er takes over the Heavenly Insight and Nether Condensation from you for a closer look.
9000328.ch: 顾鸢儿从你手中接过天目镜和冥晶，端详了一番。

9000329.en: No wonder I felt it so familiar at the time. It turns out to be the last Artifact dad made. Would you hold the Heavenly Insight so that I can melt the Nether Condensation with it?
9000329.ch: 难怪当时我就觉得如此熟悉，没想到竟然是爹爹最后制作的一件法宝，天目镜你来拿着，我将冥晶融入其中。

9000330.en: After that, Gu Yuan'er starts to leverage her energy to turn the Nether Condensation into liquid and slowly inject it into the Heavenly Insight. Soon enough, the mirror emits a dazzling glow. You feel a little dizzy. And many strange memories cross your mind.
9000330.ch: 言毕，顾鸢儿运转灵力，将冥晶化成液状，缓慢导入天目的镜面之中，数息之后，镜面光芒大作，你的眼前一阵眩晕，脑海里再次泛起诸多陌生片段。

9000331.en: In the mirror, you see that Gu Nangang hands over the Heavenly Insight to Xiang Lingjun.
9000331.ch: 片段之中，你看见顾南罡将天目镜递给向令钧。

9000332.en: Master, this mirror can be used to track Jiuying. But it must not be used often, or it would affect your mind.
9000332.ch: 盟主，此镜可以追寻九婴踪迹，切不可多用，否则会影响你的心智。

9000333.en: You mean it will be a threat to its user?
9000333.ch: 你是说，此物会反噬使用者？

9000334.en: Yes. The Heavenly Insight operates through Nether Air. Unlike Qi which can strengthen one's mind, Nether Air will corrode it. Whoever uses it for a long time will become a puppet of the Artifact and a slave of Nether Air.
9000334.ch: 不错，天目镜通过冥气运转，不同于灵气能强化人的神识，冥气会腐蚀人的神识，若长久使用，使用之人会成为法宝的傀儡，冥气的奴仆。

9000335.en: Hmm... Is that right? I don't care as long as I can get Jiuying killed. After that, I will just seal it.
9000335.ch: 唔……这样么，只要能够击杀九婴，纵然反噬，我也顾不得那么多了，杀死九婴后将其封存起来就好。

9000336.en: Ahem. Jiuying triggered the self-explosion of Nether Air before its death. Master, you seem seriously injured...
9000336.ch: 咳咳，这九婴老妖，临死前竟然引动冥气自爆，盟主，你的伤势看着不轻啊……

9000337.en: ...Nangang, you are heavily injured as well. I'm afraid it may take years to recuperate.
9000337.ch: ……南罡，你伤势也颇重啊，经此一役，怕不是要修养数年。

9000338.en: You see Gu Nangang handing over a monster's cub to Master...
9000338.ch: 你看见顾南罡手捧一只妖兽幼崽将之递给向令钧。

9000339.en: While I was searching nearby, I heard a cub crying. Then I found this...
9000339.ch: 我刚在附近稍微搜索，竟听到幼兽啼哭之声，然后找到这个……

9000341.en: Yes. Jiuying tried to kill us at the cost of its own life only because it wanted to protect its cub. It will be a threat to our Alliance after it grows up... We must kill it.
9000341.ch: 不错，九婴老妖妄图与我们玉石俱焚，原来是为了保护幼兽，此幼兽长成之后恐怕又会成我仙盟劲敌……眼下必须杀死此兽。

9000342.en: Hang on... Nangang, if we raise Jiuying since childhood... is it possible for us to curb the monster waves by controlling Jiuying? In that way, we will be able to control monster waves!
9000342.ch: 且慢……南罡，你想想，若我们从小培养九婴，是不是……是不是有可能通过控制九婴来控制兽潮？修仙者控制兽潮！

9000343.en: No, we know little about Nether Air. Chi You feeds on Nether Air. If we keep this cub alive, it may turn against us one day.
9000343.ch: 不，我们对冥气了解太少，赤幽州以冥气为食，我们若留下此幼崽，很有可能养虎为患。

9000344.en: I see... You are right... Nangang, what's that over there? Jiuying is not dead!
9000344.ch: 这样么……南罡你说得不错……南罡你看那是什么？九婴竟未死去！

9000345.en: What?! I'll hold it off. You go back to the Alliance first!
9000345.ch: 什么？！我来抵挡，你先撤回仙盟！

9000346.en: In your memories, there is a teenager trapped in a cell, opposite which is also a cell, where a woman with wounds all over is sitting. Unexpectedly, it is Duanmu Yinglan!
9000346.ch: 你画面之中，一名少年被困住牢房内，在他对面，亦有一处牢房，里面坐着一位浑身伤痕的女子，竟是你不久前见过的端木影澜。

9000347.en: How come there are so many wounds on you? What did they do to you today?
9000347.ch: 你身上怎么如此多的伤痕，他们今日又对你做了什么！

9000348.en: ...No need to pretend to care about me? In the eyes of the humans, I'm just a mindless monster that knows only to kill.
9000348.ch: ……你何必假意关心，在你们人族眼中，我不过是只凭空造杀戮的妖兽罢了。

9000349.en: No, that's not the case. In my eyes, you can think and communicate. You are not a mindless monster.
9000349.ch: 不，在我眼里，你会思考，会沟通，又怎么会是只知屠戮的妖兽呢。

9000350.en: Haha. How pretentious of you! You will definitely hide away when I show you the true me.
9000350.ch: 呵呵，只怕我现出真身，你就躲得远远了。你们人族，尽是这等冠冕堂皇之徒。

9000351.en: Then try me. I won't be scared!
9000351.ch: 那你可以试试，我是否会被你吓到。

9000352.en: In the picture, as the Jiuying monster roars, the surrounding walls are all cracked. The young man gently touches its head and hands her the Heavenly Insight.
9000352.ch: 画面之中，一只九婴妖兽咆哮嘶吼，周围洞壁尽皆震裂，这名少年轻轻抚摸着九婴的头，将天目镜递给她。

9000353.en: See? I have never been frightened by your appearance. Take this Heavenly Insight and they will never find you again. Go back to your home.
9000353.ch: 你看，这么多次了，我从来都不会被你的模样吓到，这天目镜你拿走，他们便再也找不到你了，回到本该属于你的家园去吧。

9000355.en: I will leave as well. But you haven't recovered yet. You don't stand a chance against him. Just run!
9000355.ch: 我自会离开此地，你束缚刚刚解除，实力未恢复，还无法和那个魔头对抗，快走！

9000356.en: Beast Chaos is looking forward, and a woman walks near. It is Duanmu Yinglan.
9000356.ch: 混沌凶兽面向前方，一名女子轻轻走来，竟是端木影澜。

9000357.en: Did you transform just to find that guy? Don't you know that we and the humans are enemies?
9000357.ch: 你变成这副模样是去找那个家伙？人族和我们是生死之敌，你怎么会不知呢。

9000358.en: I know, but I can't help it...

9000359.en: Is it worth it for a human...
9000359.ch: 为了一个人类，真的值得吗……

9000360.en: If not for him, I'm afraid you wouldn't be able to see me again.
9000360.ch: 若没有他，只怕你也见不到我了。

9000361.en: Ah, you are a monster, not a human. It will be very dangerous for you to get near the wall. Be careful.
9000361.ch: 哎，你是妖非人，一再接近城墙，终究十分危险，小心一点。

9000364.en: Good. Compared with last time, you look much better this time.
9000364.ch: 那便好，比起上次，你这次脸色好多了

9000366.en: After melting Nether Condensation with the Heavenly Insight, a white light spot appears on the dark purple mirror. It is moving slowly.
9000366.ch: 只见天目境在注入冥晶后，幽紫色的镜面上现出了频繁闪烁的白色光点，正在缓慢移动。

9000367.en: This spot must indicate where Jiuying is located. Unexpectedly, it is not in the depth of Chi You, but somewhere beyond the city walls.
9000367.ch: 看来这白色光点，便是九婴所在位置，根据方位推算，它竟不在赤幽州深处疗伤，而且在城墙之外的某处。

9000368.en: Wait a minute. I'll go with you.

9000369.en: You have a more important task, that is, to wait for Elder Luo to come back. When you see her, tell her to not move around. Just wait for me.
9000369.ch: 你有更重要的任务，便是在此地等骆长老回来，若她回来后，让她哪都不要去，等我归来。

9000371.en: There may be some secrets... Anyway, just do as I said.
9000371.ch: 有些事，可能另有隐情……总之听我话，你在这里等你姑姑回来。

9000372.en: Okay... I hope that you can come back as soon as possible. By the way, I made some elixirs the other day. You may take them with you just in case of emergency.
9000372.ch: 好……那你早点归来，前些日子我炼制了一些丹药，你带着，以备不时之需。

9000373.en: Follow the instructions of the Heavenly Insight, and you see a nine-headed monster at the indicated location.
9000373.ch: 你跟随天目境的指引，距离目标地点不远处，你果然看见一只九头妖兽正在向远方观望。

9000374.en: As you are about to assassinate Jiuying, a guarding monster jumps at you. It is Taotie, the Monster of Chaos.
9000374.ch: 你正想暗中击杀九婴，不想旁边竟另有守卫，一直妖兽朝你猛扑而来，竟是混沌凶兽—饕餮。

9000375.en: Although you managed to kill Taotie, Jiuying has taken the opportunity to flee into the depth of Chi You. Despite the help of the Heavenly Insight, you have to retreat.
9000375.ch: 你虽然击杀饕餮，九婴亦因此遁去到赤幽州深处，纵然有天目境标注位置，你也只能就此收手。

9000376.en: Forget it. I'd better get back to Elder Luo now. There seems to be a secret behind the death of Yuan'er's father.
9000376.ch: 罢了，先回骆长老处，当年鸢儿她爹的死亡，只怕另有隐情。

9000377.en: Upon your return, Gu Yuan'er runs toward you, crying in anxiety.
9000377.ch: 你刚回来，顾鸢儿便满脸焦急地跑到你面前，泣不成声。

9000379.en: The Master came to see my aunt. In the beginning, their conversation went pretty well. Yet all of a sudden, they started to fight. No one knew what it was about.
9000379.ch: 那盟主来找姑姑，两人本来好好，但不知聊到了什么，但突然便打了起来。

9000380.en: At last, my aunt lost and had to flee toward the forest in the distance.
9000380.ch: 两人交战后，姑姑修为不及盟主，不久前便遁往了远处的山林之中。

9000381.en: I don't know what to do other than waiting for you to return. {name|A}, would you help my aunt out?
9000381.ch: 我，我不知该怎么办，只能躲起来等你回来，{name|A}，你，你能不能去救一下姑姑……

9000383.en: You step forward to wipe her tears off. Gradually, she stops crying, yet still stares at you with her watery eyes.
9000383.ch: 你走上前，轻轻地帮顾鸢儿擦干了眼角的泪水，她的抽泣声便小了下去，渐渐止住了哭泣，只用一双含泪的眼睛凝望着你。

9000385.en: When you arrive at the forest, you see Luo Ying being knocked to the ground by Xiang Linjun. Just as Luo Ying is about to be stabbed, you strike Xiang Lingjun back.
9000385.ch: 你们来到一处山林之中，便看到骆瑛被向令钧击倒在地，就在其刺向骆英之际，你出手将之击退。

9000386.en: Gu Yuan'er runs toward Luo Ying and helps her get up.
9000386.ch: 顾鸢儿赶忙跑到骆英身旁，将其扶了起来。

9000387.en: Aunt! {name|A} and I are here to save you! Fear not!
9000387.ch: 姑姑，我和{name|A}来救你了，不要怕！

9000388.en: Why are you here? Just leave! Xiang Lingjun has been eroded by Nether Air. He is not the Alliance Master we previously knew.
9000388.ch: 你们，你们怎么来了，快走，向令钧已被冥气侵蚀，他早已不是我们的仙盟之主了。

9000389.en: You ants cannot get away from me.
9000389.ch: 你们这三只蝼蚁，谁都跑不掉。

9000390.en: Xiang Lingjun, was Yuan'er's father killed by you back then?
9000390.ch: 向令钧，当年鸢儿他爹是不是被你……

9000391.en: The Heavenly Insight must have fallen into your hands, right? You are right. Gu Nangang was so pedantic that I had to kill him for the sake of the Cultivator Alliance...
9000391.ch: 看来天目境已经落入你的手中了吧，不错，顾南罡此人太过迂腐，为了仙盟的未来，我只能杀了他……

9000392.en: Hearing Xiang Lingjun's words, Gu Yuan'er is stunned.
9000392.ch: 向令钧话音刚落，顾鸢儿便在原地呆住了。

9000393.en: Wasn't my father killed by Jiuying?
9000393.ch: 爹，爹不是死在九婴之手吗……

9000394.en: After the fight with Jinying, your father didn't die. They even found the cub of Jiuying.
9000394.ch: 当年九婴一战，南罡前辈并没有死，他们甚至还发现了九婴幼崽。

9000395.en: If he didn't die, then why? Cub of Jiuying? Could it be...?
9000395.ch: 南罡若未死，那为何？九婴幼崽，难道……

9000396.en: Yes. Gu Nangang intended to kill the cub, while Xiang Lingjun insisted on bringing up the cub. So Xiang killed him from behind while he was off guard...
9000396.ch: 不错，南罡前辈欲立刻诛杀九婴幼崽，但向令钧却想着将幼崽抚养长大，于是向令钧便趁南罡前辈不注意，从背后将其杀害……

9000397.en: If we can control Jiuying, we might be able to curb monster waves. It is something we've never imagined before. I can't figure out a reason why he would stop me.
9000397.ch: 若能控制九婴，岂不是意味着能控制兽潮，修仙者来控制兽潮啊，这是从来没有人做到的事，顾南罡他凭什么阻止我！

9000398.en: As the truth is revealed, Luo Ying, who is healing herself on the ground, is irritated and can't help but spurt out a mouthful of blood.
9000398.ch: 随着当年真相的浮现，坐在地上疗伤的骆英顿时气急攻心，止不住喷了一口鲜血出来。

9000399.en: For so many years, the person who killed my brother has been by my side. I did not avenge my brother's death but did a lot of things for him... How ridiculous!
9000399.ch: 可笑啊，这么多年来，杀兄仇人就在我身旁，我非但不为兄报仇，竟还替他干了诸多事……

9000400.en: You... you killed my father. I'm gonna kill you!
9000400.ch: 你，你竟然杀了我爹，我要为他报仇！

9000401.en: Before you have time to react, Gu Yuan'er has pulled out the sword and stabbed at Lingjun. However, she is repelled by Lingjun and falls to the ground.
9000401.ch: 你还未来得及反应，顾鸢儿便拔出手中之剑，对向令钧刺去，却被向令钧一招击退，跌到在地。

9000402.en: How dare you! I've already reached the Transcendent Realm. You are no match for me.
9000402.ch: 萤火之光，也敢与皓月争辉，本座堂堂登仙大圆满，岂是你们能够战胜的。

9000403.en: Do not be fooled by this person, {name|A}. His realm has failed to reach IX for a long time. He went to the Ancient Gate years ago but returned in defeat after battling Xingtian, and his old wounds have not yet healed...
9000403.ch: {name|A}小友，别被此人唬住，他的境界早就不圆满了。此人当年曾前往太古玄门，和刑天一战后败退回来，旧伤一直未曾治愈……

9000404.en: You are really noisy. I'm gonna kill you first!
9000404.ch: 你这老妇，实在聒噪，本座先将你杀了。

9000405.en: Xiang Linjun leaps into the air and casts a spell that generates a huge array. From the middle of the array rises a giant sword that stabs at Luo Ying.
9000405.ch: 向令钧跃至空中，双手掐诀祭出巨大法阵，法阵之中凝出一道浩瀚的剑意，刺向骆英。

9000406.en: After a prolonged fight, you defeat Xiang Lingjun.
9000406.ch: 这一战，打得山河变色，所在的山头都被你们打烂，最终，经过许久的鏖战，你击败了向令钧。

9000407.en: I lost. How could this be...

9000408.en: My friend, many things that happened back then remain a mystery. Can you give this person to me so that I can figure it out?
9000408.ch: 小友，当年许多事仍然成谜，可否将此人交给老身，让我一一查明。

9000409.en: Xiang Linjun sits down on the ground, losing every bit of his Qi after the battle just now. Luo Ying walks up to him and looks down at him indifferently.
9000409.ch: 向令钧颓废瘫坐在地上，经过刚才的一战，他灵气尽失，和凡人没有什么区别。骆瑛走到他身前，冷漠地俯视着他。

9000410.en: You, Nangang, and I were sworn brothers and sisters. We used to fight monsters and protect the people together. Those were the most precious memories of our life. Why does it turn out like this?
9000410.ch: 向师兄，当年你，我，南罡三人，在那高山之巅结义，随后一起战妖兽、护百姓，那段经历是我人生中最宝贵的回忆，为何如今却到了如此境地。

9000411.en: Forget it. It happened a long time ago. Kill me if you will.
9000411.ch: 那都是多少年前的旧事了，你要杀便杀，何必如此惺惺作态。

9000412.en: You've changed. You are not the big brother I used to respect.
9000412.ch: 你果然变了，已经不是当年那个我敬重的大哥了。

9000413.en: Haha. People change. You should have known that.
9000413.ch: 哈哈，师妹，是个人都会变的。

9000414.en: After that, Xiang Lingjun suddenly rises and holds Luo Ying hostage. You find that Xiang Lingjun is surrounded by a layer of Nether Air.
9000414.ch: 话音刚落，却见向令钧猛然起身，将骆瑛挟持在手中。你竟发现，此刻的向令钧，浑身上下在散发着冥气。

9000415.en: You have been practicing the use of Nether Air? Do you know that you will turn into a monster?
9000415.ch: 你，你竟然修行了冥气，你可知这样下去你会变成妖兽的！

9000416.en: I don't intend to. It's you who force me to do this.
9000416.ch: 我本不想走到这一步的，是你们，是你们逼我的。

9000418.en: Haha. Try me. See whether Luo Ying will die first or I will.
9000418.ch: 笑话，有本事你们出手试试，看看是我先死，还是这骆瑛先死。

9000419.en: After saying that, Xiang Linjun takes Luo Ying with him and flies into the air. Suddenly, a true fire comes across the air to hit Xiang Linjun, who is forced to let go of Luo Ying. In an instant, Xiang is turned into a fireball and burned to ashes soon enough.
9000419.ch: 说完，向令钧便挟持着骆瑛向空中飞去。突然一声婴鸣响起，一团真火横空而来，打中向令钧，他被迫放开骆瑛，却瞬间变成火球，不多时彻底烧成了人形焦炭。

9000420.en: Jiuying flies over and transforms into a human. Turns out she is Duanmu Yinglan.
9000420.ch: 只见九婴妖兽破空而至，化作人形，正是你之前见过的端木影澜。

9000421.en: Shenghan, finally I killed this guy for you...
9000421.ch: 胜寒，我终于为你杀了此人……

9000422.en: Ahem, Jiuying, how dare you come to the Cultivator Alliance alone?
9000422.ch: 咳咳，九婴，你竟然敢独身来仙盟，莫不是欺我仙盟无人……

9000423.en: Haha. Do you think you can stop me?

9000424.en: Duanmu Yinglan ignores Luo Ying as she comes to Xiang Lingjun's body to fetch something. Then she glances at you coldly as if indicating you to follow up.
9000424.ch: 端木影澜无视骆瑛，来到向令钧的尸体旁，取走了什么东西，随后冷冷地看了你一眼，在远处等候，似有让你跟上之意。

9000425.en: Don't go. This monster is way too powerful. You won't be able to handle it.
9000425.ch: 你别去，这九婴妖兽实力强大，你一人前去，太过危险。

9000426.en: If Jiuying intended to kill us, she would have done it early on. Would you take Mentor Luo back for treatment? I shall go and see what she is up to.
9000426.ch: 若九婴想杀我们，早就动手了，何必等到现在。我且去看看，你先带骆前辈回去疗伤。

9000427.en: You follow Duanmu Yinglan to a hidden Mystic Realm. She presses something in her hand to open the door to the realm and you follow through.
9000427.ch: 你跟随端木影澜，来到了一处隐秘的洞天秘境之外，只见九婴激活手中之物，秘境大开，你随她走了进去。

9000428.en: The mystic realm turns out to be a cell, which is exactly the same as the one you saw when the Heavenly Insight was activated.
9000428.ch: 秘境之中竟然是一处牢房所在，和你当初在天目境激活的片段中看到的某处场景一模一样。

9000429.en: You go inside with Duanmu Yinglan, just to see a young man lying on the ground, who seems to be alive but has died already.
9000429.ch: 你随着端木影澜往里走去，看到有一名少年躺在地上，虽然面目栩栩如生，但生机已绝。

9000430.en: Duanmu Yinglan, who did not show any emotions previously, starts to sob when she sees the corpses of the young man. She kneels beside him and strokes his face.
9000430.ch: 原本没有任何情绪的端木影澜，看到眼前的尸体，顿时跪坐在一旁，轻轻抚摸着少年的脸，无声地抽泣着。

9000431.en: It takes a long while before Duanmu Yinglan speaks up.
9000431.ch: 许久之后，端木影澜终于开口。

9000432.en: You must have seen everything from the Heavenly Insight, haven't you?
9000432.ch: 想必你已经从天目境中看到了吧……

9000433.en: I left it behind intentionally so that you could see it. I knew you were different from other cultivators. But I didn't expect that you could help me kill Xiang Lingjun so soon.
9000433.ch: 那本就是我特地留给你的，我看得出，你和其他修士不同，能助我杀了向令钧，让我意外的是，这一刻竟来得这么快。

9000435.en: Duanmu Yinglan looks at the dead body on the ground again, with tenderness in her eyes.
9000435.ch: 端木影澜再次看向地上的尸体，目光里尽是温柔。

9000436.en: His name is Duanmu Shenghan. My name was given by him.
9000436.ch: 他叫端木胜寒，我的名字，还是他起的。

9000437.en: The look in her eyes becomes even softer as she is lost in memories. It looks like she is not worried that you would do something behind her back.
9000437.ch: 端木影澜的目光愈发柔和，陷入了往事的回忆之中，似乎并不担心你会在背后动手。

9000438.en: Back then, I was caught by Xiang Lingjun and imprisoned here for a long time. I was often beaten and used for experiments to the point that I almost became a ferocious mindless monster. It was Shenghan who helped me suppress the cruelty in my heart.
9000438.ch: 当初，我被向令钧抓回，长久囚于此地，时常挨打，被拿去做实验，我一度要变成失去灵智的凶兽，是胜寒帮我压制住内心的戾气。

9000439.en: At the darkest time when I could not see any hope, it was he who brought me the light.
9000439.ch: 那个时候，我看不到一丝希望，是他带给我唯一的一点光亮，陪我度过那段最黑暗的时光。

9000440.en: He was the only one who was not afraid of seeing the real me. Rather, I saw the tenderness in his eyes.
9000440.ch: 他是唯一看到我妖兽真容后不会害怕之人，相反，我在他眼里看到的满是心疼之意。

9000441.en: Later on, he did everything he could to help me out and even stole the Heavenly Insight for me so that I would never be at the risk of being discovered again.
9000441.ch: 他后来拼尽了一切助我脱身，更是将天目境取给了我，让我从此再无被发现之危。

9000442.en: To steal the Heavenly Insight, he was captured by Xiang Lingjun again. After I escaped, it didn't take long before I became the leader of the monsters because I was a descendant of Jiuying. So I launched many monster waves in an attempt to rescue him. Unfortunately, I was never able to break through the walls.
9000442.ch: 为了偷天目境，他被向令钧再度抓走。而我逃出去后，由于是九婴后裔，很快就成为了妖兽之首，于是频繁发动兽潮，企图把他救出，但始终无法攻破城墙。

9000443.en: It is not until you show up that I set up this scheme to kill Xiang Lingjun.
9000443.ch: 直到你出现后，我才设下此计，终于将向令钧杀了。

9000444.en: But I'm late after all. Shenghan has left me...
9000444.ch: 可我还是来晚了，胜寒还是离我而去了……

9000445.en: As he had been staying by my side, his body had been transformed by Nether Air. Even though he is dead, his flesh will not decay.
9000445.ch: 他常年在我身边，体质早已被冥气改造，哪怕死了，肉身也不会腐化。

9000446.en: This is the end of her memories. As the tenderness in her eyes gradually dissipates, she becomes Jiuying, the leader of monsters, again.
9000446.ch: 回忆到这里也到了落幕的时刻，端木影澜目光的温柔之意尽数消散，重新变成了妖兽首领—九婴。

9000447.en: {name|A}, I know you are on your way to Tian Yuan Mountain. If you can defeat me, I will be at your disposal and no monsters will harass you anymore.
9000447.ch: {name|A}，我知你到此地是为前往天元山，若你此战击败我，我任凭你处置，沿途妖兽我也不会让他们来侵扰你。

9000448.en: Otherwise, please leave Chi You and stay out of the conflicts between me and the Cultivator Alliance.
9000448.ch: 若我战胜你，请你离开赤幽州，勿管我妖兽与仙盟之事。

9000449.en: Taotie was my friend after all. So this fight between us is inevitable.
9000449.ch: 被你击杀那饕餮终究是我朋友，这一战避无可避。

9000450.en: Be careful. I will go all out in this fight.
9000450.ch: 小心了，此战我定会全力以赴……

9000451.en: After being defeated by you, Jiuying transforms back into a human. She sits slowly by the corpse of Duanmu Shenghan, seemingly relaxed and relieved, rather than disappointed.
9000451.ch: 九婴妖兽最终不敌你手，慢慢变回人身，最后缓缓坐在端木胜寒的尸体旁，脸上并无任何失望之意，反倒有些轻松和释然。

9000452.en: You have unbelievable talent indeed. Among all the human cultivators I've ever seen, you are the best.
9000452.ch: 你的天赋果然强悍，我见过的人族修士中，你当属第一。

9000453.en: I've had enough of this. Today I'm finally relieved. {name|A}, would you kill me now...
9000453.ch: 这一切，我承受得太累了，今日终于可以解脱。{name|A}，你可以动手了……

9000454.en: Duanmu Yinglan is pitiful indeed. But she is Jiuying after all. If you don't kill her, she might be a big problem in the future. Just as you are hesitating, Gu Yuan'er arrives.
9000454.ch: 这端木影澜其实也是个可怜人，你一时无法下手，但她终究是九婴，若不杀她，只怕恐成大患，就在你犹豫之时，顾鸢儿出现了。

9000455.en: {name|A}, how are you doing? Are you hurt? What about Jiuying?!
9000455.ch: {name|A}，你怎么样了，有没有受伤，那九婴呢？！

9000456.en: You did it! Why don't you take the opportunity to kill it to avenge the death of our disciples?
9000456.ch: 你，你竟然打败了它，那趁现在赶紧杀了它，为仙盟死去的弟子报仇！

9000457.en: Gu Yuan'er, who was keen to kill Duanmu Yinglan, is moved to tears after hearing her story.
9000457.ch: 本来一心要杀端木影澜的顾鸢儿，在听完你的讲述后，竟然感动得哭了起来。

9000459.en: After a while of silence, Gu Yuan'er suddenly recalls something and whispers secretly in your ear.
9000459.ch: 一片沉默之下，顾鸢儿突然想到了什么，在你耳边偷偷私语。

9000461.en: It's just dad's guess, but we may try as well. If it works, that's good; otherwise, we'll just kill her without feeling guilty.
9000461.ch: 这是爹当年的猜想，不妨一试，若可行最好，不行那便只要杀了她，你我也无愧于心。

9000462.en: Just then, you jump over Duanmu Yinglan's head, cast magic as Gu Yuan'er told you, and a spell is slowly activated in the mind of Duanmu's mind.
9000462.ch: 只见你来到端木影澜头顶，按照顾鸢儿所说，运转法力，只见一道禁咒被缓缓落入端木影澜的脑海里

9000463.en: She collapses to the ground, looking desperately weak.
9000463.ch: 而端木影澜一时间瘫倒在地上，虚弱至极

9000464.en: Hooray! Seems that dad's spell works on human-looking monsters as well! You don't have to kill her!
9000464.ch: 成功了！看来爹爹的这道禁咒对化形妖兽也起作用，生死都掌握在你的一念之间了。

9000465.en: Duanmu Yinglan sits up from the ground slowly, feeling the changes in her body, looking puzzled.
9000465.ch: 端木影澜也缓缓的从地上坐了起来，感受着身上的变化，露出了疑惑之色。

9000467.en: Now there is a spell in your body. If you hurt humans, {name|A} will kill you in a second.
9000467.ch: 你体内有一道禁咒，若你做出陷害人族之事，{name|A}一念之间便可杀死你。

9000468.en: We pity you, so we'll let you go this time. But if you dare to sin again, we will hold you accountable.
9000468.ch: 念你也是个可怜人，我们便放你一条生路，若我发现你再行错事，就不会再放过你。

9000469.en: I'm grateful for staying with Shenghan forever. I assure you that I'm just Duanmu Yinglan from now on. Jiuying no longer exists in this world.
9000469.ch: 能永远陪在胜寒旁边，我就满足了，你们放心，从此只有端木影澜，再无九婴。

9000470.en: With these words, Duanmu Yinglan takes the hand of Duanmu Shenghan to her face, looking at him lying beside her gently.
9000470.ch: 说完，端木影澜看向躺在一旁的端木胜寒，缓缓拿起他的手放到自己脸上，目光里充满温柔。

9000471.en: {name|A}, let's go. The cave is secluded from the world, she can just live here.
9000471.ch: {name|A}，我们走吧，这方洞天幽深隐秘，便让她在此处生活吧。

9000472.en: You leave this cave, and behind you Duanmu Yinglan is still kneeling beside Duanmu Shenghan, watching him motionlessly like a statue.
9000472.ch: 你们离开了这处洞天，身后的端木影澜依旧痴痴地跪坐在端木胜寒的身旁，宛如雕像。

9000473.en: By the way, I found some pieces of paper in the cave. You can take them if you find them useful.
9000473.ch: 对了，这是我在秘窟中发现的几张纸，不知道有没有用，你拿去看看。

9000474.en: Then let's go back. Aunt must be worried.
9000474.ch: 那我们回去吧，姑姑肯定担心坏了。

9000476.ch: 安全回来就好，那九婴如何了？

9000477.en: {name|A} has defeated her and cast a spell on her, so she can no longer hurt people.
9000477.ch: 那九婴被{name|A}打败了，如今给她下了禁咒，再也无法害人了。

9000478.en: Good. Without Jiuying, the monsters who have lost their leader are hopeless for the time being.
9000478.ch: 如此便好，没了九婴，妖兽失去首领，短时间内不成气候。

9000479.en: Great, we've taken revenge for our father, and Jiuying is no longer a problem for us, all credit to {name|A}!
9000479.ch: 真好，替爹爹报了仇，还解决了九婴之患，这一切都是{name|A}的功劳。

9000480.en: {name|A}, please take {0} as a reward for the great deed you've done.
9000480.ch: {name|A}道友，这{0}便是你此番大功的奖励，快拿去吧，切莫推辞。

9000481.en: Luo Ying hands over the reward to you, but his brow is still furrowed, as if he is being pestered by something else.
9000481.ch: 你看到骆瑛把奖励给你后，眉头依然紧皱，似还有烦心之事。

9000482.en: You look grim. Is there something still bothering you?
9000482.ch: 看骆前辈眉头紧锁，可是有何烦恼？

9000483.en: After Xiang Lingjun was killed by Jiuying, the Alliance is left leaderless. So, a few days ago, we Elders began to discuss how to find a successive Master.
9000483.ch: 向令钧被九婴击杀后，这盟主之位空悬，偌大的仙盟不能群龙无首，前几日，我们一众长老便开始商议盟主继任之事。

9000484.en: But it's so difficult to find a successor who is capable enough to convince everyone.
9000484.ch: 一时之间，竟找不到足以服众的继任之人。

9000485.en: I may have done my part for the Alliance all these years, but I don't think I'm the right person to be the new Alliance Master. There are many outstanding people in the Alliance. It's my duty to find the most suitable one for the position.
9000485.ch: 老身任职长老以来，或有几分苦劳，但这盟主之位，自问还不够资格，仙盟之中，能人众多，把最适合的人选挑出来，才是老身职责所在。

9000486.en: You're right. We did come up with a method to appoint the Master.
9000486.ch: 道友所言甚是，我们确实得出了一法来决定盟主之位。

9000487.en: Our Alliance once had an artifact sharp awl named {itemLink7000110}, which was forged to combat the Demonic god Xingtian. But Sharp Awl disappeared with an Elder after he took it to suppress a powerful monster.
9000487.ch: 昔日我仙盟著有一法宝利锥，名为{itemLink7000110}，是为对付魔神刑天所制，但此物被当时一位长老拿去镇压一只实力极强的妖兽后，便随着长老一起失踪了。

9000488.en: So we've decided that any member of the Alliance will become Master as long as he or she brings back {itemLink7000110}.
9000488.ch: 所以我们决定，凡是我仙盟成员，谁先带回{itemLink7000110}，便成为仙盟之主。

9000489.en: You mean this sounds rash? No, in fact, we guess that Sharp Awl is likely to be used to suppress that ancient monster. To bring the awl back, one should have the power to kill the monster, and is therefore proved able to become the Master.
9000489.ch: 你是想说有些儿戏？其实不然，我们猜测，此物很可能在镇压那只上古妖兽，若有人能带回，便意味着那人有击杀此妖兽之力，这番修为足以成为盟主。

9000490.en: Moreover, to head into the Tian Yuan Mountain, you must defeat the Demonic god. If you get {itemLink7000110}, the chances of defeating him will be higher.
9000490.ch: 况且，若你想进入天元山，就必须打败魔神刑天，若得{itemLink7000110}，击败刑天的胜算便多几分。

9000491.en: Luo Ying's words remind you that since this object can hurt Xingtian, you must do whatever you can to get it.
9000491.ch: 骆瑛一言，倒是提醒了你，此物既然能伤害到刑天，那无论如何也要将其拿到手中。

9000492.en: I will go and find {itemLink7000110}, but as for succeeding as Master...
9000492.ch: 我愿前去找寻{itemLink7000110}，但这盟主之位……

9000493.en: We can decide later when you return.
9000493.ch: 盟主之位回来再说便是。

9000494.en: Yuan'er, I remember that you have studied the location of {itemLink7000110}, right?
9000494.ch: 鸢儿，我记得你曾经研究过{itemLink7000110}所在之地，是不是？

9000495.en: Yeah, dad tried to look for it, but unfortunately, he was pushed back by waves of monsters. But he has left many clues.
9000495.ch: 对呀，当年爹爹便打算寻回这枚锥子，可惜找到一半便被兽潮打断，但还是留下了诸多线索。

9000497.en: Of course. According to these clues, I search through tons of books and estimated the approximate location.
9000497.ch: 当然啦，我根据这些线索，又翻了很多书籍，估算出了大概位置。

9000498.en: At this, Gu Yuan'er takes out a piece of paper, on which there is the topography of Chi You with a mark on a specific place.
9000498.ch: 说完，顾鸢儿便拿出一张纸，在上面画出赤幽州的地形，在其中某处地方标记了一下。

9000499.en: We are highly likely to find {itemLink7000110} in the place I marked.
9000499.ch: 我标记的这个地方，有很大可能便是{itemLink7000110}所在之地。

9000500.ch: 那等等我，我跟你一起去！

9000501.en: Come on, the monster suppressed by Sharp Awl is almost as ferocious as Jiuying. Look at you, don't screw it up.
9000501.ch: 胡闹，利锥所镇妖兽不比九婴差多少，你这点实力，去了不是给道友添乱的吗？

9000502.en: Well... take care then, {name|A}. I, I'm waiting here for you to come back.
9000502.ch: 好吧……那{name|A}，你一定要万分小心，我，我在此等你回来。

9000503.en: You arrive there and find a bottomless abyss, from which comes a special wave of air. You decide to dive in and see what's happening.
9000503.ch: 你刚到此地，便看到一条望不见底的深渊，深渊之中传来一丝特殊的波动，你决定潜入进去，探索一番。

9000504.en: You go deep underground and see a monster lying prone. Its hands are nailed to the ground by a purple awl...
9000504.ch: 你深入地底，只见一只妖兽伏在地上一动不动，它的手被一枚紫色的利锥穿透钉在地上……

9000505.en: You pull it out, and to your surprise, the monster stands up again with a shake. A voice comes from the depths of the cave...
9000505.ch: 你拔出锥子，妖兽抖动一下竟然重新站起,同时，一个声音在洞穴中徐徐响起……

9000506.en: Who... has unsealed me... It's you, wicked human... let me eat you first... to replenish my essence...
9000506.ch: 是谁……替吾解了封印……竟是你这可恶的人族……让吾先吃了你……补充一丝真元……

9000507.en: After being sealed off for so long, this monster is much weaker than before and is killed by you after a fierce battle.
9000507.ch: 此妖遭到长年封印，实力已远不如前，一番激战后终于被你击杀。

9000508.en: Now that you have retrieved the awl, why not give it to Elder Luo?
9000508.ch: 既已取得此锥，便拿回去交给骆长老。

9000510.en: Luo Ying takes the Exorciser from you, looking surprised.
9000510.ch: 骆瑛从你手中接过辟魔，脸上满是惊讶之色。

9000511.en: Y-You are strong, {name|A}. You even managed to retrieve the {itemLink7000110}!

9000512.en: I, Luo Ying, Elder of the Cultivator Alliance, hereby request {name|A} to take over the position of the Master of our Alliance.
9000512.ch: 在下仙盟长老骆瑛，在此请求{name|A}道友接下这仙盟盟主之位。

9000513.en: You have killed Taotie, defeated Jiuying, and even recaptured this Exorciser. Everyone in the Cultivator Alliance is expecting you to become the new Master. Please do not refuse us.
9000513.ch: 道友杀饕餮，败九婴，如今都夺回这辟魔，仙盟上下都在期望着你成为盟主，还请不要推辞了。

9000514.en: I, Luo Ying, welcome our new Master.

9000515.en: I, Gu Yuan'er, welcome our new Master.

9000516.en: After you become the Master of the Alliance, you lead your men to repel two waves of monster attacks, and successfully clear thousands of miles of land outside the Alliance.
9000516.ch: 你接任盟主之后，亲自主持击退两次兽潮，将仙盟外数千里地重新肃清。

9000517.en: Without Jiuying at their command, the Wave of Monsters has waned, so you move the Alliance forward to the old line of defense on the advice of Luo Ying, with her help.
9000517.ch: 骆瑛眼看兽潮失去九婴主持，实力大减，便建议你将仙盟重新迁移到旧日防线。

9000518.en: You officially take the position of the Alliance Master on the day the move is finished. During the grand ceremony, you accept the seal of the Alliance Master, and all the Alliance members applaud and cheer for you. The yell of "Master" is heard all over Chi You.
9000518.ch: 仙盟重回旧日防线之时，亦是你正式接任仙盟盟主之日，这一日，你接过盟主印信，仙盟万众归心，同时下拜。山呼盟主之声，震于赤幽之州。

9000519.en: Master is really a genius. You've made things new in the Alliance shortly after you accepted the seal. The tattered monsters are now nothing to be afraid of.
9000519.ch: 盟主不愧是人中龙凤，这才掌管仙盟未久，整个仙盟的气象便焕然一新，妖兽也不成气候。

9000521.en: I still remember that Master came to Chi You because you wanted to go to Tian Yuan Mountain.
9000521.ch: 我还记得，盟主当初来赤幽州，可是为了前往天元山？

9000522.en: The Cultivator Alliance was first established to deal with this Nether Air crisis, but we later discovered that Nether Air is related to Xingtian, who guards the Ancient Gate. If we want to solve the problem of the Nether Air, we must first eliminate Xingtian.
9000522.ch: 我仙盟建立之初，便是为了解决这冥气之祸，后来发现，这冥气竟然和那镇守在太古玄门的魔神刑天有关，若要解决冥气之祸，必须击杀刑天。

9000523.en: That Ancient Gate is also the only entrance to Tian Yuan Mountain. Master, it seems our next goal is to defeat the Demonic god Xingtian.
9000523.ch: 而那太古玄门，亦是通往天元山的唯一入口。盟主，可见我们当下的目标，便是击败这魔神刑天。

9000524.en: But if you want to defeat Xingtian, you need to find a way to resist the Nether Air, otherwise you will be eroded even before you get close to him.
9000524.ch: 但若要击败刑天，需先找到克制冥气侵蚀之法，否则还没接近刑天，自身便已被冥气侵蚀。

9000525.en: A few days ago, I was looking through the ancient books of the Cultivator Alliance and found out that there is a giant tree southwest of Chi You. Qi surrounds that tree, and Nether Air is thin. It appears that it's able to restrain the Nether Air somehow.
9000525.ch: 前些日子我翻阅仙盟古籍，发现在赤幽州西南角有一参天巨树，那巨树周围，灵气充斥，冥气稀薄，显然是有克制冥气之法。

9000526.en: Yes, Xiang Lingjun went there once, and he said no one could approach the big tree with arrays around it. Now it seems that it's not the truth.
9000526.ch: 不错，当年向令钧曾去过一次，说大树周围凶险重重，无法靠近，如今看来，恐怕事实并非如他所言。

9000527.en: Another fierce battle has broken out ahead. Two Alliance disciples are knocked to the ground, and one disciple is snatched by the monster. Feng Yunchuo charges over to knock over the monster and takes back the snatched disciple, but he gets scratched by the monster's claw...
9000527.ch: 前方再度传来激战声响，仙盟弟子被打倒两名，其中一人还被妖兽抓住。风允婼飞身撞倒妖兽，将被抓弟子抢回，同时亦被妖兽一爪抓伤……

9000528.en: Monster... Monsters are so powerful... Chief Feng, shall I... help you?
9000528.ch: 妖兽……妖兽好厉害……风族长，我来……我来助你吧？

9000529.en: Feng Yunchuo, why did you interfere in our business time and again?
9000529.ch: 风允婼，你一再干预我等仙卫，究竟是何用意？

9000530.en: What? Chief Feng saved you, and you are blaming him?
9000530.ch: 啊？风族长出手相救，你还怪他？

9000531.en: Hmph, this person is also from Mu Xian and must be close to this demon. I saw them chatting just now!
9000531.ch: 哼，这人也是从暮仙州来的，看起来是和这怪物做一路的，刚刚他们还聚一起说话呢！

9000532.en: Gu Yuan'er, Chief Feng is the strongest cultivator in this world. With his help, you may even stop Xingtian from brandishing the Axe and the Shield. You will only waste your talent back here.
9000532.ch: 顾鸢儿，风族长天下无敌，有他相救，你就是阻止刑天舞动干戚也做得了。一直留在后方实在大材小用。

9000533.en: These Alliance disciples seem to look down upon cultivators from the outside world. They take their leave after leaving some sarcastic remarks.
9000533.ch: 这些仙盟弟子似乎十分看不起来自外界的修仙者，他们阴阳怪气的责怪你们几句，这才悻悻然离开。

9000534.en: Hmph, they only want to take all the credit for killing the monster when they report to Aunt Luo!
9000534.ch: 哼，这些家伙就想着击杀了妖兽好向骆姑姑请功！

9000535.en: Hero, Yuan'er, you must be tired. Our camp is not far from here. Let's go and take a rest there.
9000535.ch: 恩人，鸢儿，大家都累了，我族营地离此不远，便去歇息歇息吧。

9000536.en: Yeah! I can chat with Lixi again!
9000536.ch: 好啊！我最爱跟里希妹子说话了。

9000537.en: Feng Yunchuo is standing on high ground, looking at the Alliance wall in the distance. He doesn't look much different from when you last saw him, but he seems to be troubled.
9000537.ch: 风允婼当时正立足一块高地上，眺望远处仙盟城墙。别来之后他并无多大变化，只是脸上有几分苦恼之色。

9000538.en: It was a heavy blow, but I was strong enough and didn't take too much damage. Were you also invited to the Alliance by Elder Luo?
9000538.ch: 妖兽出手虽重，所幸身子硬朗，并无大碍。恩人可是也受到骆长老邀请因此来到仙盟之中？

9000539.en: I was received warmly and treated as an honored guest by Elder Luo when I first came to Chi You. With your power, you will win Elder Luo's favor in no time.
9000539.ch: 风某当日初到赤幽州，即为骆长老奉为上宾并礼请到此。道友实力不弱，相信马上亦会得骆长老倚重。

9000540.en: It may be surprising to you that the Alliance in Chi You stands in great solidarity after being separated from the outside world and overcoming so many disasters. Hmm... immortals and mortals are the same when it comes to the evil within. Something's different in the Cultivator Alliance after all compared with the sects out there.
9000540.ch: 恩人或许不信。赤幽州仙盟长期与外界隔绝，又屡遭大难，竟十分团结。唔……人心鬼蜮，天下一同；但仙盟较之于外界宗门，终究有些不同。

9000541.en: The Alliance is committed to repelling the Wave of Monsters and resolving the leaking Nether Air to protect the world. I feel sympathy for their cause since I'm also working to rid my people of the Nether Air.
9000541.ch: 再者仙盟心系八荒诸州，素以抵挡兽潮，解决冥气外泄的祸患为己任。风某有个心愿，那便是让族人摆脱冥气之祸，这倒与仙盟志向不谋而合。

9000542.en: Excuse me! Aunt Luo said she wanted to see Chief Feng...and...you too...
9000542.ch: 啊！骆姑姑有请风族长……还有……你……

9000544.en: You follow Feng Yunchuo to the Alliance to meet Luo Ying. She is scolding several Alliance disciples.
9000544.ch: 你随风允婼来到仙盟与骆瑛相见。当时她正呵责几名仙盟弟子。

9000545.en: How dare you tease someone who saved your life? Apologize to Chief Feng!
9000545.ch: 岂有此理！受人救命之恩，还敢看不起人？这便与风族长道歉吧！

9000548.en: Thank you for saving us... If not for you, we could have been killed by the monster...
9000548.ch: 多谢风族长救命之恩……若非有风族长出手，我们几个可能已被妖兽杀死……

9000549.en: As fellow members of the Alliance, it's only natural for us to look after each other. Hmm, now I'm afraid I must rush back to tend to some urgent affairs in my tribe. Please excuse me.
9000549.ch: 既是仙盟中人，原应互相照料。唔，风某族中扔有事情要待处理，这便先回去了。

9000550.en: Yuan'er told me you killed the monster by yourself after Chief Feng had been wounded. Our Cultivator Alliance is always thirsty for talents. I hope you could join us and lend us your strength.
9000550.ch: 听鸢儿说，当时风族长被妖兽所伤，乃是你独自击杀妖兽的。仙盟向来求贤若渴，因此骆瑛十分希望你成为我仙盟中人，为仙盟效力。

9000551.en: I heard from Chief Feng that you were looking for the path to the Tian Yuan Mountain, but it is blocked by the Ancient Gate. If you join our Alliance, we could join hands to kill Xingtian and reopen the Ancient Gate. Then you will be able to go to the Tian Yuan Mountain.
9000551.ch: 我听风族长提过，你一直追寻通往天元山的道路，眼前前路已被太古玄门封闭。你不妨加入仙盟，与我们合力消灭刑天重新打通太古玄门。到时你就能进入天元山了。

9000553.en: You must be tired after the fierce battle today. You should get some rest first, and we can talk about it another day. Gu Yuan'er, see to it that our guest is well accommodated.
9000553.ch: 今日经历激战，你也累了，不妨先去休息，我们日后再作详谈不迟。顾鸢儿，好好安顿贵客。

9000554.en: Aunt Luo... Could you let me join the battle against the Wave of Monsters next month... I want to help the Alliance to kill monsters beyond the wall. Please allow me to teleport through the wall!
9000554.ch: 骆姑姑，你……下个月我也想参与兽潮之战……我想到城墙之外，击杀妖兽替仙盟出力。请允许我使用阵法往返于城墙内外！

9000555.en: We'll talk about this later. I told you to take this guest to rest.
9000555.ch: 此事以后再说。现在先带这位道友去休息吧。

9000557.en: The place for rest is just over there. There, see? You can go there by yourself, right?
9000557.ch: 休息的地儿就在不远。喏，那儿。你自个而去吧。

9000559.en: My friend, Elder Luo is waiting for you.

9000560.en: Cultivator Alliance Elder Luo Ying once indicated her wish for you to join the Alliance. This time she will probably give you an official invitation. It might be the key to entering the Tian Yuan Mountain. You should consider it properly.
9000560.ch: 此前仙盟长老骆瑛曾表示希望你加入仙盟，估计此去她会正式邀请你加入。此事与进入天元山有莫大关联，应该好好考虑。

9000561.en: Now you're here, let's cut to the chase. I invited you to join the Alliance the other day. Have you made up your mind?
9000561.ch: 道友既来，老身便开门见山吧。日前邀请你加入仙盟，此事可已考虑好了？

9000562.en: Good. I'm looking forward to fighting side by side with you against the monsters. Xi Zhao, I'll leave the rest to you.
9000562.ch: 嗯，老身正期待日后与道友一同对付妖兽。奚照，剩下的事你与道友说。我先走一步。

9000564.en: My friend, this is a difficult time for our Alliance, so our Elder hopes you could complete some missions published in the Alliance Mission Hall during the next few months to tide us over.
9000564.ch: 道友，目前仙盟正是多事之秋，因此长老希望接下来几个月道友到仙盟任务大厅完成上面发布的任务，以解我仙盟燃眉之急。

9000565.en: Elder Luo managed to find time in her busy schedule to meet you in the Wenji Mansion. She really thinks highly of you.
9000565.ch: 骆长老近日分身乏术仍然特意回到问机别院与道友见面，可见长老有多看重道友了。

9000569.en: She's gone? I really can't figure her out. My friend, I'm looking forward to your performance.
9000569.ch: 怎么就走了？这孩子总叫人弄不明白。道友，奚照期待你建功于仙盟。

9000570.en: I once read in an ancient book that Muzheng Goumang once set apart some of his focus into this world.
9000570.ch: 昔日风某查阅一本八荒古纪，里面说五行神木正句芒曾分出一丝神识来到这八荒之中。

9000571.en: The real reason for his arrival is beyond us, but according to that book, his focus has always been fighting with Xingtian in Chi You...
9000571.ch: 木正降临八荒的真正原因，已无从得知。但古纪曾说言木正神识在赤幽州与刑天争持不下……

9000572.en: I have always been committed to finding out the source of Nether Air and finding a way to rid my tribesmen of the suffering it caused.
9000572.ch: 一直以来，风某的心愿便是探索冥气源头，设法让族人日后不必再受冥气之苦。

9000573.en: I always thought nothing was impossible for me, but since I came here and saw Xingtian waving his shield and axe in the distance, I realized it was much more complicated.
9000573.ch: 风某自觉这天底下没有我做不成的事情。但来此以后，看见远方舞动干戚的刑天，便知事情并不简单。

9000574.en: *sigh* Muzheng is an immortal from the heavenly world. Despite the restriction he is subject to in this world, his focus is still overwhelmingly powerful. If even he cannot bring down Xingtian, how can it be possible for me to achieve my goal?
9000574.ch: 唉！想那木正乃上界仙人，来到八荒之地，遭受限制，但尽管如此，祂的一缕神识也已非同小可。木正尚且与不敌刑天，风某真的能做到所想之事么？

9000575.en: *sigh* How sad my tribesmen will continue to suffer!
9000575.ch: 唉，只心疼我的族人，还要受那无穷无尽的苦楚！

9000576.en: My friend, Elder Luo is always a warm-hearted person, though sometimes we may think her apathetic. These days she is busy handling matters of the Alliance, in order to bring us out of tough times. If you feel neglected, I'll express our apology to you here...
9000576.ch: 道友，骆长老一向面冷心热，目前仙盟正是多事之秋，她事务繁忙，若有怠慢之处还请你见谅……

9000577.en: Also, there is a thing worth celebrating recently. The Cultivator Alliance intends to establish a new Sect, and seeing your Sect is so prosperous, Elder Luo asked me to inquire about your attitude toward a plan...
9000577.ch: 不过，此间却有一桩天大喜事，仙盟近日正欲再建一座宗门，骆长老见道友的宗门发展蓬勃，故嘱托在下务必让道友答应一事……

9000579.en: That is, to move your Main Sect to Chi You. The Cultivator Alliance has already picked a blessed land for your Sect to settle down.
9000579.ch: 那便是将贵宗的总舵迁往赤幽州，仙盟已然选好风水宝地供贵宗落脚。

9000580.en: At the same time, the Cultivators in Chi You will also join you. After the original leading cultivators in your Sect reached Reborn and Transcendent, they could also be dispatched by the Sect to Chi You, for your assistance.
9000580.ch: 同时，赤幽州的修仙者也会加入其中，待贵宗原有骨干成长至羽化登仙境，他们也能通过宗门调度来到赤幽州与道友并肩作战。

9000581.en: So, I humbly express my hope to you here - please give us your consent, and the Cultivator Alliance will surely do its best to support your Sect!
9000581.ch: 在下恳请道友答应此事，仙盟必将尽全力扶持道友之宗门！

9000582.en: Thank you very much! Therefore, I'll help you to get things done!
9000582.ch: 在下拜谢！如此，我便动身帮助道友搬迁！

9000586.en: My friend, this time you could settle down in our Sect. And our Elder hopes you could complete some missions published in the Alliance Mission Hall during the next few months to assist us in developing the Alliance.
9000586.ch: 如此，道友可在宗门内好生安居，长老希望接下来几个月道友到仙盟任务大厅完成上面发布的任务，以助我仙盟发展。

9000591.en: It's you again. Must you be everywhere?

9000592.en: Hmph, you're working hard! I'm sure you will win Aunt Luo's favor and be the number one favorite in the Alliance!
9000592.ch: 哼，真勤奋啊！祝你早日搏得骆姑姑注意，扶摇直上，成为盟中要人！

9000593.en: Yuan'er, Master couldn't possibly allow us to go out there and reclaim the Heaven Sacrifice Altar. Just forget it, and stop asking me to teach you spells. I have nothing more to teach you!
9000593.ch: 鸢儿，盟主不可能让咱们出外收回祈天台的。我看你趁早死心了吧。你也不要老是缠着我教你符法了，我也没啥可教啦。

9000594.en: The spells left behind by Elder Gu are much more advanced than mine. Why don't you study your father's works?
9000594.ch: 顾长老临去之前留下的符法可比我的高深多了。你啊，倒不如多钻研钻研你父亲的遗作？

9000595.en: Aunt Luo said one must learn from various schools to make greater achievements! She is too busy to teach me, so I'm asking you instead!
9000595.ch: 骆姑姑说，要想在一个事业上有所成就，必须博采百家之长嘛！再说，骆姑姑平日十分繁忙，这不才缠着你教我么？

9000596.en: Elder Luo will not be pleased if she finds out what I have taught you. I should get going! Oh, who is this?
9000596.ch: 骆长老要知道我还教你这些，恐怕要不高兴。我们赶紧散了吧？咦，这谁？

9000597.en: It's you! What are you doing sneaking here?
9000597.ch: 是你？鬼鬼祟祟在这干嘛？

9000598.en: Eh, see you then! I'm leaving...
9000598.ch: 呃，咱们改天再聊，走了走了……

9000599.en: Gu Yuan'er is fighting a monster, but she gets struck, and her weapon falls to the ground. With one knee on the ground, she wants to fight back, but seems wounded and unable to stand up.
9000599.ch: 顾鸢儿与一只妖兽对战，只不过片刻就给妖兽击中，打落手上兵器。她半跪在地，正要起身再战，但似乎已经受了伤，站之不起。

9000600.en: Hmph, you saved me again. I really can't stand you. Don't you pretend to be friendly and lend me your arm! I don't deserve it! Ouch...
9000600.ch: 哼，又被你救了一命。真是受不了，到哪都给比下去。千万别来假惺惺的说要扶我回去，我受不起。哎，痛痛痛……

9000601.en: Gu Yuan'er snaps her fingers and makes a fire in the dry cave ahead to warm her hands.
9000601.ch: 顾鸢儿眼看面前洞穴颇为干燥，便打个响指在地上点起火头伸手取暖。

9000602.en: This is the monster repelling fire Aunt Luo gave me. Monsters won't dare come near. You can leave me here.
9000602.ch: 这是骆姑姑给我的驱妖之火，妖物不会靠近，我很安全，你可以走了。

9000603.en: Hmph, why are you asking? The Heaven Sacrifice Altar was built by the early members of the Alliance a long time ago. They used it to pray for the arrival of the fire bird in Chi You to repel the Nether Air. It was managed by the Alliance since then and became one of our strongholds.
9000603.ch: 哼，你问这个干嘛？祈天台是仙盟先辈建造的高台。希望借此祈求天上火鸟降临赤幽州帮忙驱散冥气。后来由仙盟要人经营，成为仙盟重地。

9000604.en: In fact, Aunt Luo also wants to take back the Altar. She actually wants to demolish it, use the materials to fortify the new wall, and also recover important cultivator literature inside.
9000604.ch: 其实骆姑姑也想将祈天台夺回的。她盼着夺回后拆去祈天台，再用上面的材料加固新城墙，当然还要回收里面许多重要仙家文献。

9000605.en: You overheard a lot! I wanted to learn spells so that I could break the seal of a room in the Altar. There is something in there I want to take back.
9000605.ch: 上回偷听了不少东西嘛！我学习符法是希望解开里面一间密室的封印，我想取回里面的东西。

9000606.en: They...belonged to my father. He left a book named Chi You Anecdotes there. I want to read it...
9000606.ch: 那是……那是我父亲的东西。他留下了一卷《赤幽别志》在里头。我希望看看里面的东西……

9000607.en: Gu Yuan'er turns her head aside as she speaks...
9000607.ch: 顾鸢儿说着将头别了过去……

9000608.en: You... won Aunt Luo's favor not long after you came here, yet she won't let me go out there to fight the Wave of Monsters even though I was brought up by her. I can't stand getting surpassed by more and more people... I should be an outstanding figure in the Alliance, just like my father!
9000608.ch: 你……才来就受到骆姑姑的重视。我由她一手带大，她却始终不让我外出对付兽潮。我受不了给一个又一个人超过……我应该像爹爹一样，是仙盟中出类拔萃的人物！

9000609.en: Hmph, why am I telling you this?! I can't make a realm breakthrough, I'm not allowed to fight the Wave of Monsters, and I'm always a child in Aunt Luo's eyes! I will never take back my father's belongings from the Altar! Not even in my next life!
9000609.ch: 可恶，谁要跟你说这个？！一直无法突破境界、一直无法外出抵御兽潮、一直给骆姑姑轻视！我这辈子，不，下辈子都没希望前往祈天台取回爹爹的东西了！

9000610.en: Gu Yuan'er stands up abruptly and stamps out the fire before she turns around and limps away.
9000610.ch: 顾鸢儿突然站起，一脚踢灭火焰。随后她猛地转身一拐一拐的跑了开去。

9000611.en: You follow Gu Yuan'er far behind. She is not wandering off as you fear but walking back to the Alliance. Suddenly, you hear a telepathic voice from her: thank you.
9000611.ch: 你远远跟随顾鸢儿，她没有周围乱走，只是回到仙盟之中。突然间你耳际响起顾鸢儿的传音。她说：谢了。

9000613.en: Gu Yuan'er stands far from you, and glimpses at your side. Then, she tears down a poster of a high-level Mission in the Mission Hall, and rushes out angrily...
9000613.ch: 顾鸢儿在远处看了看你这边，然后伸手撕下一张任务大厅的高阶任务，气冲冲的跑了出去……

9000615.en: Gu Yuan'er, leaning on the bulletin board, gives a cough and eyes you meaningfully. There is a smile on her lips.
9000615.ch: 顾鸢儿正靠在布告栏上，她咳嗽一声，意味深长的看了你一眼，而嘴角却分明带着一丝笑意。

9000616.en: *cough* There is a monster, no, maybe more than one, that is beyond my power. Could you just... help me this time? You won't be doing this for nothing!
9000616.ch: 咳！！就是有一只妖兽，啊不，可能不止一只，我收拾不了。你能不能……就帮我一下？不会叫你白忙活的！

9000617.en: Okay... I'll be waiting for you here! Do remember...to come!
9000617.ch: 好……我在这等你！你……记得要来。

9000618.en: Just follow me, and don't tell anyone! Okay? See that array ahead? Let's go.
9000618.ch: 你跟我来，不要声张！一定不要！就是前面那个阵法，我们走。

9000619.en: That's odd... It should be opened like this. I've tried it several times. Do you...know how this works? This array is sealed off by spells... Hmm. A1, f6, Tongren, Dayou... It works! Come in now.
9000619.ch: 奇了……应该就是这样开启的呀，试了好多次了。你……你懂不懂这个？这个阵法用符咒封印了……唔，甲一巳六，同人大有……啊好了！快进来。

9000620.en: You step into the array and are teleported beyond the wall. Gu Yuan'er walks ahead, pointing to the distance. An altar is towering in front of you.
9000620.ch: 你踏入阵法之后，竟传送到城墙之外。顾鸢儿走在前方指点远处。放眼看去，一座高台耸立眼前。

9000622.en: Just as you arrive at the foot of the altar, a monster appears around the corner...
9000622.ch: 你们刚到台下，转角处突然扑出一只妖兽……

9000623.en: You hold it back, and I'll take a look over there!
9000623.ch: 你帮忙抵挡一下，我周围看看！

9000624.en: After you finish off the monster, you see Gu Yuan'er running out of the entrance to the altar toward you. She is chased by a lot of monsters...
9000624.ch: 你解决妖兽后，顾鸢儿从高台入口飞奔出来，她身后烟尘滚滚，大量妖兽蹑背急追朝你迎面逼来……

9000625.en: Run, run... They are too many... We must return to the array...
9000625.ch: 快走快走……打不过……回去阵法那边……

9000627.en: In the twinkling of an eye, you and Gu Yuan'er are teleported back to town. Still frightened, she slumps down to the ground and gasps for breath.
9000627.ch: 眨眼间你与顾鸢儿已传回城中，顾鸢儿惊魂未定，坐倒在地吁了口气。

9000628.en: Do we have to wait for the Day of Clear Sky? Ha... It's too much for me. Luckily you were there... Don't tell Aunt Luo about what happened today. Don't tell anyone! Never! Here, take this. My gratitude.
9000628.ch: 莫非还得等候天清之日？唉……这根本应付不来啊。多亏有你……这事不许说给骆姑姑知道。不，谁也别说。记得别说啊！喏，这玩意送你，说了不叫你白忙活的。

9000630.en: My friend, Elder Luo wants to see you. She is waiting for you in the Wenji Mansion outside the Alliance.
9000630.ch: 道友，骆长老有请，她目前正在仙盟之外的碧桃嘉馆等候。

9000631.en: Luo Ying sent someone to invite you to meet her in Azure Peach Mansion outside the Alliance.
9000631.ch: 骆瑛托人传讯，希望你到仙盟外碧桃馆一聚。

9000632.en: Just as you arrive at the Azure Peach Mansion, you hear bickering from inside. Through the gate, you see the cold face of Elder Luo and the red face of Gu Yuan'er. They seem to be quarreling.
9000632.ch: 你才到碧桃嘉馆，就听到里面传来争吵之声。从馆中门户可以看见骆长老面若寒霜，顾鸢儿脸红耳赤，两人正在口角。

9000633.en: Aunt Luo, Elder Luo, when will you let me out of town? You allow Chief Feng to leave the town, and even that... newcomer can accept missions in the Cultivator Alliance. Only I am locked in the town like a prisoner.
9000633.ch: 骆姑姑，骆长老，你什么时候才肯让我出城？风族长你准允离城，那个……那个新来的家伙你也准允在仙盟之中自由活动。就只有我像坐牢一样留在城中。

9000634.en: Isn't it beneficial for the Alliance to reclaim the Altar? The documents in there are all treasures! You too advised Alliance Master to reclaim it time and again. Why do you want to destroy it now?
9000634.ch: 收回祈天台，对仙盟也有莫大好处不是？那里面收藏的资料都是宝贝啊！姑姑，你自己不也向盟主几番请求收回祈天台么？怎么突然就说要毁去祈天台呢？

9000635.en: The things the Alliance deals with are multifarious and overwhelming, so keep quiet and just do as Master said.
9000635.ch: 仙盟之事，千头万绪，岂是你这小姑娘能知晓？盟主自有他的考虑。

9000636.en: Hmph, I know you opened a secret portal no one knows, and it has threatened the safety of the Alliance. I'll destroy it, and you must stay in the Alliance. Guards, keep a close eye on Gu Yuan'er from now on!
9000636.ch: 再说，你私自开启一个封存已久无人知晓的传送阵，可知对仙盟有多大隐忧？近日我设法毁去阵法，你就乖乖留在仙盟之中。来人，寸步不离看好顾鸢儿！

9000638.en: Hmph! You're always treating me like a child. Like a garrulous mother!
9000638.ch: 呸！一天到晚管管管，不知道的还以为你是我妈呢！

9000640.en: Elder Luo, please calm down. I will make sure to keep a close eye on Yuan'er.
9000640.ch: 呃、长老安心，属下定会看好鸢儿的。

9000641.en: Yuan'er, please. Hmm... Why are you staring at me? Go!

9000642.en: How embarrassing... It's a Day of Clear Sky today, and a day like this always reminds me of a problem that has been troubling the Alliance for a long time. Alliance Master has decided to demolish the Heaven Sacrifice Altar and use its bricks to fortify our new city wall. But the altar is always swarmed with ferocious monsters. I wonder if you have any good ideas for how to get rid of them?
9000642.ch: 叫道友笑话了……今日是天清日，这种日子总叫老身想起一个困扰仙盟许久的难题。盟主决定近日便要拆毁祈天台回收外壁精石以加固新城墙。但祈天台附近常有凶兽盘踞，因此想问问道友可有妙计除去凶兽？

9000643.en: Nether Air permeates the sky of Chi You and blocks the sun most of the time. Only once in every three eyes does the sky clear up, hence the name Day of Clear Sky. The early members of the Alliance believed it was the best time to commune with heaven, so they went to the Altar to pray for the arrival of the Immortal Bird. The spells in the Altar are also most effective on such a day.
9000643.ch: 赤幽州中常年弥漫冥气，不见天日，只三年一次阴霾散开露出青天，故称为天清日。仙盟先辈以这日子与上苍最无阻隔，因此前往祈天台顶祈求仙鸟降临。祈天台之中搭建的禁咒符法亦于此时效用最大。

9000644.en: That's why it'd also be the best time for us to reclaim the Altar. Yuan'er quarreled with me over this many times before, but not on such a scale.
9000644.ch: 当然，这也是收回祈天台的好时机。往日鸢儿也曾与我争执，只没想今天如此激动。

9000645.en: Yuan'er's father, Gu Nangang, was an Elder in the Alliance. He made great achievements in the study of forging, spells and artifacts. When he was young, the old city wall of the Alliance was still in our hands. He studied day and night in the Altar in order to find out the source of the Nether Air in Chi You. He left all his understandings in the book Chi You Anecdotes.
9000645.ch: 鸢儿父亲顾南罡原为我仙盟长老，他一生之中于炼器符法之道钻研极深。他年轻之时，仙盟旧城墙尚未失陷，当时他日夜埋首祈天台中钻研道法探究赤幽州冥气源头，并留下一卷《赤幽别志》。

9000646.en: Shortly after Yuan'er was born, Elder Gu died. All Yuan'er knows about her father was heard from others, and she has always been eager to retrieve that book.
9000646.ch: 鸢儿出生之际，南罡因故辞世，鸢儿耳闻的都是父亲的事迹，因此她一直很希望取得那卷《别志》。

9000647.en: Yuan'er is always taking her father as her model, and I think she wants to know more about her father from the Anecdotes. Of course, she also wants to keep Nangang's life's work alive.
9000647.ch: 鸢儿一心要成为她父亲一样的人物。因此我以为她希望从《别志》中推想往日父亲风采。当然，这也是想要保留南罡的心血之作的孝心。

9000648.en: The Heaven Sacrifice Altar was built by the early members of the Alliance to pray for the arrival of the Immortal Bird to repel the Nether Air. It later became a stronghold of the Alliance. Only the top-level members of the Alliance were allowed in there.
9000648.ch: 祈天台为我仙盟先辈建造的高台，原为祈求火鸟降临祛除冥气之用。后人经营之下，成为我仙盟要地。祈天台通常只允许仙盟要人进入。

9000649.en: It stores many of the works of our past cultivators as well as important documents of Alliance history and secrets. It was a pity that we didn't have enough time to take them all with us when the Wave of Monsters breached our line of defense.
9000649.ch: 里面大量存有我仙盟前辈心血之作，同时藏有仙盟纪事，记载盟中一切秘辛及大事。可惜当日兽潮冲破防线，仙盟急切间无法取走高台重要物品。

9000650.en: The Altar was protected by spells and won't be breached by even the most powerful Wave of Monsters. Our new city wall was built in the same way. *Sigh* I wish I could study the Altar to further learn more about spells cast on architecture.
9000650.ch: 另外，以符法构造的祈天台十分坚固，兽潮再强亦不易冲破。后来的新城墙构造便从祈天台的设想而来。唉，老身亦盼通过研究此台，好进一步探究施法于建筑的术法。

9000651.en: Those arrays were created by the early members of the alliance, and it is very complicated to activate them. Nangang once studied them in order to better protect the Alliance. I never could have imagined that Yuan'er inherited her father's learning and found one of those arrays.
9000651.ch: 阵法原是仙盟先辈建立，开启之法十分繁琐，往日南罡在时曾想一一探明开启这些阵法，以更好保证仙盟安全。不想鸢儿承袭父亲之学，竟找到了一个阵法。

9000652.en: Those arrays were built in the old way, and they have their limitations. It can only teleport one or two disciples at a time, and once activated, the monsters beyond the wall may also use it to sneak into the Alliance and wreak havoc.
9000652.ch: 这些阵法制式古旧，颇有弊端。每次仅能传送一两名仙盟弟子，而且一旦开启难保城墙之外的妖兽不会因此进入仙盟，大肆破坏。

9000653.en: The first generation of Alliance cultivators had a very difficult time settling down. They had to repel the monsters and guard against the infiltration of Nether Air at the same time.
9000653.ch: 第一批进入赤幽州的仙盟先辈处境十分艰难，他们既要抵挡妖兽的侵袭，亦要防范无孔不入的冥气。

9000654.en: Afterward, an Immortal Bird flew in the sky, clearing the Nether Air in its wake. So they built the Altar with the intention to commune with it and summon it to remove the Nether Air for the Alliance.
9000654.ch: 其后，一只仙鸟掠过天空，尽扫赤幽州上空阴霾。我仙盟前辈因此建造高台，盼能借此与之沟通，让其为仙盟祛除冥气。

9000655.en: *sigh* Yuan'er is a clever kid, but she is so obstinate that she can't have a stable Taoist Mind, therefore unable to make breakthroughs. She has always been quite a handful...
9000655.ch: 唉，鸢儿原本天资极高，可惜太过执着，以致于道心不稳，修为屡屡无法突破。这女孩儿总叫我操心不尽……

9000656.en: Suddenly, a roar is heard in the distance with dusts surging in the air. It can be clearly seen even from the mansion in the town.
9000656.ch: 此时远方突然发出一声轰鸣，一股尘头升上半天，虽在城墙内的别馆之中，仍然清晰可见。

9000657.en: Elder... Please forgive me! Please lend me a hand!
9000657.ch: 不、不好了……长老恕罪，长老助我。

9000659.en: Yuan'er subdued me with a spell all of a sudden... Though I broke away soon, she was nowhere to be found...
9000659.ch: 刚才鸢儿乘我不备，用奇怪的禁咒将我制住……我虽然马上挣脱，可她已经不知从哪里转了出去……

9000660.en: Oh no! Yuan'er found the deserted array. She inherited her father's learning and can use this array to teleport freely. It's the Day of Clear Sky today. Once activated, the spells in the Altar will form a powerful barrier. She wants to go inside the Altar to retrieve Nangang's belongings before Master destroys the Altar!
9000660.ch: 不妙！鸢儿发现废弃阵法。她凭借家学，能够自由出入此阵。今日是天清之日，祈天台内部禁咒一旦发动会形成强力结界。她想乘着今日之便，在盟主出手毁台之前进入祈天台取回南罡遗物！

9000662.en: Taowu, one of the four ferocious beasts in Chi You, is stationed near the Altar at Jiuying's command to stop us from reclaiming the Altar. Apparently, Yuan'er's intrusion into the Altar was discovered by Taowu, who led monsters to attack her and left her with no choice but to enter the Altar and activate the spells to resist the monsters.
9000662.ch: 赤幽州四凶之一梼杌为九婴妖兽布置在祈天台附近，防范我等回收祈天台。不问可知，鸢儿进入高台，立被梼杌察觉；梼杌率群妖攻击，鸢儿无可奈何，只好进入高台之内发动禁咒抵挡妖兽进攻。

9000663.en: It would take too long for us to go to the Altar from here... Not to mention Taowu and the monsters besieging it. It's beyond the power of a few Alliance Guards to rescue Yuan'er!
9000663.ch: 可恨，现今便是即刻离开仙盟赶往祈天台，只怕也来不及了……更莫说梼杌招集群妖，合围祈天台。救回鸢儿，只怕不是区区几名仙卫能够办下来的事！

9000664.en: Nangang... I'm sorry... I failed to take care of your daughter...
9000664.ch: 南罡……我对不起你……没给你照顾好女儿……

9000665.en: You... Take me there at once!
